1.zh: 亚哈死后，摩押背叛以色列。
1.en: Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab.

1.zh: 亚哈谢在撒马利亚，一日从楼上的栏杆里掉下来，就病了；于是差遣使者说：「你们去问以革伦的神巴力·西卜，我这病能好不能好。」
1.en: Ahaziah fell down through the lattice in his upper room that was in Samaria, and was sick. So he sent messengers, and said to them, “Go, inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, whether I will recover from this sickness.”

1.zh: 但耶和华的使者对提斯比人以利亚说：「你起来，去迎着撒马利亚王的使者，对他们说：『你们去问以革伦神巴力·西卜，岂因以色列中没有　神吗？』
1.en: But the LORD’s angel said to Elijah the Tishbite, “Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and tell them, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you go to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron?

1.zh: 所以耶和华如此说：『你必不下你所上的床，必定要死！』」以利亚就去了。
1.en: Now therefore the LORD says, “You will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.”’” Then Elijah departed.

1.zh: 使者回来见王，王问他们说：「你们为什么回来呢？」
1.en: The messengers returned to him, and he said to them, “Why is it that you have returned?”

1.zh: 使者回答说：「有一个人迎着我们来，对我们说：『你们回去见差你们来的王，对他说：耶和华如此说，你差人去问以革伦神巴力·西卜，岂因以色列中没有　神吗？所以你必不下所上的床，必定要死。』」
1.en: They said to him, “A man came up to meet us, and said to us, ‘Go, return to the king who sent you, and tell him, “The LORD says, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you send to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.’”’”

1.zh: 王问他们说：「迎着你们来告诉你们这话的，是怎样的人？」
1.en: He said to them, “What kind of man was he who came up to meet you and told you these words?”

1.zh: 回答说：「他身穿毛衣，腰束皮带。」王说：「这必是提斯比人以利亚。」
1.en: They answered him, “He was a hairy man, and wearing a leather belt around his waist.” He said, “It’s Elijah the Tishbite.”

1.zh: 于是，王差遣五十夫长，带领五十人去见以利亚，他就上到以利亚那里；以利亚正坐在山顶上。五十夫长对他说：「神人哪，王吩咐你下来！」
1.en: Then the king sent a captain of fifty with his fifty to him. He went up to him; and behold, he was sitting on the top of the hill. He said to him, “Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down!’”

1.zh: 以利亚回答说：「我若是神人，愿火从天上降下来，烧灭你和你那五十人！」于是有火从天上降下来，烧灭五十夫长和他那五十人。
1.en: Elijah answered to the captain of fifty, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty!” Then fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.

1.zh: 王第二次差遣一个五十夫长，带领五十人去见以利亚。五十夫长对以利亚说：「神人哪，王吩咐你快快下来！」
1.en: Again he sent to him another captain of fifty with his fifty. He answered him, “Man of God, the king has said, ‘Come down quickly!’”

1.zh: 以利亚回答说：「我若是神人，愿火从天上降下来，烧灭你和你那五十人！」于是　神的火从天上降下来，烧灭五十夫长和他那五十人。
1.en: Elijah answered them, “If I am a man of God, then let fire come down from the sky and consume you and your fifty!” Then God’s fire came down from the sky, and consumed him and his fifty.

1.zh: 王第三次差遣一个五十夫长，带领五十人去。这五十夫长上去，双膝跪在以利亚面前，哀求他说：「神人哪，愿我的性命和你这五十个仆人的性命在你眼前看为宝贵！
1.en: Again he sent the captain of a third fifty with his fifty. The third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and begged him, and said to him, “Man of God, please let my life and the life of these fifty of your servants be precious in your sight.

1.zh: 已经有火从天上降下来，烧灭前两次来的五十夫长和他们各自带的五十人；现在愿我的性命在你眼前看为宝贵！」
1.en: Behold, fire came down from the sky and consumed the last two captains of fifty with their fifties. But now let my life be precious in your sight.”

1.zh: 耶和华的使者对以利亚说：「你同着他下去，不要怕他！」以利亚就起来，同着他下去见王，
1.en: The LORD’s angel said to Elijah, “Go down with him. Don’t be afraid of him.” Then he arose and went down with him to the king.

1.zh: 对王说：「耶和华如此说：『你差人去问以革伦神巴力·西卜，岂因以色列中没有　神可以求问吗？所以你必不下所上的床，必定要死！』」
1.en: He said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Because you have sent messengers to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron, is it because there is no God in Israel to inquire of his word? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.’”

1.zh: 亚哈谢果然死了，正如耶和华借以利亚所说的话。因他没有儿子，[他兄弟]约兰接续他作王，正在犹大王约沙法的儿子约兰第二年。
1.en: So he died according to the LORD’s word which Elijah had spoken. Jehoram began to reign in his place in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, because he had no son.

1.zh: 亚哈谢其余所行的事都写在以色列诸王记上。
1.en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

2.zh: 耶和华要用旋风接以利亚升天的时候，以利亚与以利沙从吉甲前往。
2.en: When the LORD was about to take Elijah up by a whirlwind into heaven, Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

2.zh: 以利亚对以利沙说：「耶和华差我往伯特利去，你可以在这里等候。」以利沙说：「我指着永生的耶和华，又敢在你面前起誓，我必不离开你。」于是二人下到伯特利。
2.en: Elijah said to Elisha, “Please wait here, for the LORD has sent me as far as Bethel.” Elisha said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So they went down to Bethel.

2.zh: 住伯特利的先知门徒出来见以利沙，对他说：「耶和华今日要接你的师傅离开你，你知道不知道？」他说：「我知道，你们不要作声。」
2.en: The sons of the prophets who were at Bethel came out to Elisha, and said to him, “Do you know that the LORD will take away your master from over you today?” He said, “Yes, I know it. Hold your peace.”

2.zh: 以利亚对以利沙说：「耶和华差遣我往耶利哥去，你可以在这里等候。」以利沙说：「我指着永生的耶和华，又敢在你面前起誓，我必不离开你。」于是二人到了耶利哥。
2.en: Elijah said to him, “Elisha, please wait here, for the LORD has sent me to Jericho.” He said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So they came to Jericho.

2.zh: 住耶利哥的先知门徒就近以利沙，对他说：「耶和华今日要接你的师傅离开你，你知道不知道？」他说：「我知道，你们不要作声。」
2.en: The sons of the prophets who were at Jericho came near to Elisha, and said to him, “Do you know that the LORD will take away your master from over you today?” He answered, “Yes, I know it. Hold your peace.”

2.zh: 以利亚对以利沙说：「耶和华差遣我往约旦河去，你可以在这里等候。」以利沙说：「我指着永生的耶和华，又敢在你面前起誓，我必不离开你。」于是二人一同前往。
2.en: Elijah said to him, “Please wait here, for the LORD has sent me to the Jordan.” He said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” Then they both went on.

2.zh: 有先知门徒去了五十人，远远地站在他们对面；二人在约旦河边站住。
2.en: Fifty men of the sons of the prophets went and stood opposite them at a distance; and they both stood by the Jordan.

2.zh: 以利亚将自己的外衣卷起来，用以打水，水就左右分开，二人走干地而过。
2.en: Elijah took his mantle, and rolled it up, and struck the waters; and they were divided here and there, so that they both went over on dry ground.

2.zh: 过去之后，以利亚对以利沙说：「我未曾被接去离开你，你要我为你做什么，只管求我。」以利沙说：「愿[感动]你的灵加倍地感动我。」
2.en: When they had gone over, Elijah said to Elisha, “Ask what I shall do for you, before I am taken from you.” Elisha said, “Please let a double portion of your spirit be on me.”

2.zh: 以利亚说：「你所求的难得。[虽然如此]，我被接去离开你的时候，你若看见我，就必得着；不然，必得不着了。」
2.en: He said, “You have asked a hard thing. If you see me when I am taken from you, it will be so for you; but if not, it will not be so.”

2.zh: 他们正走着说话，忽有火车火马将二人隔开，以利亚就乘旋风升天去了。
2.en: As they continued on and talked, behold, a chariot of fire and horses of fire separated them; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

2.zh: 以利沙看见，就呼叫说：「我父啊！我父啊！以色列的战车马兵啊！」以后不再见他了。于是以利沙把自己的衣服撕为两片。
2.en: Elisha saw it, and he cried, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!” He saw him no more. Then he took hold of his own clothes and tore them in two pieces.

2.zh: 他拾起以利亚身上掉下来的外衣，回去站在约旦河边。
2.en: He also took up Elijah’s mantle that fell from him, and went back and stood by the bank of the Jordan.

2.zh: 他用以利亚身上掉下来的外衣打水，说：「耶和华—以利亚的　神在哪里呢？」打水之后，水也左右分开，以利沙就过来了。
2.en: He took Elijah’s mantle that fell from him, and struck the waters, and said, “Where is the LORD, the God of Elijah?” When he also had struck the waters, they were divided apart, and Elisha went over.

2.zh: 住耶利哥的先知门徒从对面看见他，就说：「[感动]以利亚的灵感动以利沙了。」他们就来迎接他，在他面前俯伏于地，
2.en: When the sons of the prophets who were at Jericho facing him saw him, they said, “The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha.” They came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.

2.zh: 对他说：「仆人们这里有五十个壮士，求你容他们去寻找你师傅，或者耶和华的灵将他提起来，投在某山某谷。」以利沙说：「你们不必打发人去。」
2.en: They said to him, “See now, there are with your servants fifty strong men. Please let them go and seek your master. Perhaps the LORD’s Spirit has taken him up, and put him on some mountain or into some valley.” He said, “Don’t send them.”

2.zh: 他们再三催促他，他难以推辞，就说：「你们打发人去吧！」他们便打发五十人去，寻找了三天，也没有找着。
2.en: When they urged him until he was ashamed, he said, “Send them.” Therefore they sent fifty men; and they searched for three days, but didn’t find him.

2.zh: 以利沙仍然在耶利哥等候他们回到他那里；他对他们说：「我岂没有告诉你们不必去吗？」
2.en: They came back to him while he stayed at Jericho; and he said to them, “Didn’t I tell you, ‘Don’t go’?”

2.zh: 耶利哥城的人对以利沙说：「这城的地势美好，我主看见了；只是水恶劣，土产不熟而落。」
2.en: The men of the city said to Elisha, “Behold, please, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord sees; but the water is bad, and the land is barren.”

2.zh: 以利沙说：「你们拿一个新瓶来，装盐给我」；他们就拿来给他。
2.en: He said, “Bring me a new jar, and put salt in it.” Then they brought it to him.

2.zh: 他出到水源，将盐倒在水中，说：「耶和华如此说：『我治好了这水，从此必不再使人死，也不再使地土不生产。』」
2.en: He went out to the spring of the waters, and threw salt into it, and said, “The LORD says, ‘I have healed these waters. There shall not be from there any more death or barren wasteland.’”

2.zh: 于是那水治好了，直到今日，正如以利沙所说的。
2.en: So the waters were healed to this day, according to Elisha’s word which he spoke.

2.zh: 以利沙从那里上伯特利去，正上去的时候，有些童子从城里出来，戏笑他说：「秃头的上去吧！秃头的上去吧！」
2.en: He went up from there to Bethel. As he was going up by the way, some youths came out of the city and mocked him, and said to him, “Go up, you baldy! Go up, you baldy!”

2.zh: 他回头看见，就奉耶和华的名咒诅他们。于是有两只母熊从林中出来，撕裂他们中间四十二个童子。
2.en: He looked behind him and saw them, and cursed them in the LORD’s name. Then two female bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of those youths.

2.zh: 以利沙从伯特利上迦密山，又从迦密山回到撒马利亚。
2.en: He went from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Samaria.

3.zh: 犹大王约沙法十八年，亚哈的儿子约兰在撒马利亚登基作了以色列王十二年。
3.en: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.

3.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，但不至像他父母所行的，因为除掉他父所造巴力的柱像。
3.en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, but not like his father and like his mother, for he put away the pillar of Baal that his father had made.

3.zh: 然而，他贴近尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，总不离开。
3.en: Nevertheless he held to the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from them.

3.zh: 摩押王米沙牧养许多羊，[每年]将十万羊羔的毛和十万公绵羊的毛给以色列王进贡。
3.en: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder; and he supplied the king of Israel with one hundred thousand lambs and the wool of one hundred thousand rams.

3.zh: 亚哈死后，摩押王背叛以色列王。
3.en: But when Ahab was dead, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

3.zh: 那时约兰王出撒马利亚，数点以色列众人。
3.en: King Jehoram went out of Samaria at that time, and mustered all Israel.

3.zh: 前行的时候，差人去见犹大王约沙法，说：「摩押王背叛我，你肯同我去攻打摩押吗？」他说：「我肯上去，你我不分彼此，我的民与你的民一样，我的马与你的马一样。」
3.en: He went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, saying, “The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me against Moab to battle?” He said, “I will go up. I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.”

3.zh: 约兰说：「我们从哪条路上去呢？」回答说：「从以东旷野的路上去。」
3.en: Then he said, “Which way shall we go up?” Jehoram answered, “The way of the wilderness of Edom.”

3.zh: 于是，以色列王和犹大王，并以东王，都一同去绕行七日的路程；军队和所带的牲畜没有水喝。
3.en: So the king of Israel went with the king of Judah and the king of Edom, and they marched for seven days along a circuitous route. There was no water for the army or for the animals that followed them.

3.zh: 以色列王说：「哀哉！耶和华招聚我们这三王，乃要交在摩押人的手里。」
3.en: The king of Israel said, “Alas! For the LORD has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”

3.zh: 约沙法说：「这里不是有耶和华的先知吗？我们可以托他求问耶和华。」以色列王的一个臣子回答说：「这里有沙法的儿子以利沙，就是从前服事以利亚的。」
3.en: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there a prophet of the LORD here, that we may inquire of the LORD by him?” One of the king of Israel’s servants answered, “Elisha the son of Shaphat, who poured water on the hands of Elijah, is here.”

3.zh: 约沙法说：「他必有耶和华的话。」于是以色列王和约沙法，并以东王都下去见他。
3.en: Jehoshaphat said, “The LORD’s word is with him.” So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

3.zh: 以利沙对以色列王说：「我与你何干？去问你父亲的先知和你母亲的先知吧！」以色列王对他说：「不要这样说，耶和华招聚我们这三王，乃要交在摩押人的手里。」
3.en: Elisha said to the king of Israel, “What have I to do with you? Go to the prophets of your father, and to the prophets of your mother.” The king of Israel said to him, “No, for the LORD has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.”

3.zh: 以利沙说：「我指着所事奉永生的万军耶和华起誓，我若不看犹大王约沙法的情面，必不理你，不顾你。
3.en: Elisha said, “As the LORD of Armies lives, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I respect the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Judah, I would not look toward you, nor see you.

3.zh: 现在你们给我找一个弹琴的来。」弹琴的时候，耶和华的灵就降在以利沙身上。
3.en: But now bring me a musician.” When the musician played, the LORD’s hand came on him.

3.zh: 他便说：「耶和华如此说：『你们要在这谷中满处挖沟；
3.en: He said, “The LORD says, ‘Make this valley full of trenches.’

3.zh: 因为耶和华如此说：你们虽不见风，不见雨，这谷必满了水，使你们和牲畜有水喝。』
3.en: For the LORD says, ‘You will not see wind, neither will you see rain, yet that valley will be filled with water, and you will drink, both you and your livestock and your other animals.

3.zh: 在耶和华眼中这还算为小事，他也必将摩押人交在你们手中。
3.en: This is an easy thing in the LORD’s sight. He will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.

3.zh: 你们必攻破一切坚城美邑，砍伐各种佳树，塞住一切水泉，用石头糟踏一切美田。」
3.en: You shall strike every fortified city and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all springs of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.’”

3.zh: 次日早晨，约在献祭的时候，有水从以东而来，遍地就满了水。
3.en: In the morning, about the time of offering the sacrifice, behold, water came by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.

3.zh: 摩押众人听见这三王上来要与他们争战，凡能顶盔贯甲的，无论老少，尽都聚集站在边界上。
3.en: Now when all the Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them, they gathered themselves together, all who were able to put on armor, young and old, and stood on the border.

3.zh: 次日早晨，日光照在水上，摩押人起来，看见对面水红如血，
3.en: They rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone on the water, and the Moabites saw the water opposite them as red as blood.

3.zh: 就说：「这是血啊！必是三王互相击杀，俱都灭亡。摩押人哪，我们现在去抢夺财物吧！」
3.en: They said, “This is blood. The kings are surely destroyed, and they have struck each other. Now therefore, Moab, to the plunder!”

3.zh: 摩押人到了以色列营，以色列人就起来攻打他们，以致他们在以色列人面前逃跑。以色列人往前追杀摩押人，直杀入摩押的境内，
3.en: When they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and struck the Moabites, so that they fled before them; and they went forward into the land attacking the Moabites.

3.zh: 拆毁摩押的城邑，各人抛石填满一切美田，塞住一切水泉，砍伐各种佳树，只剩下吉珥·哈列设的石[墙]；甩石的兵在四围攻打那城。
3.en: They beat down the cities; and on every good piece of land each man cast his stone, and filled it. They also stopped all the springs of water and cut down all the good trees, until in Kir Hareseth all they left was its stones; however the men armed with slings went around it and attacked it.

3.zh: 摩押王见阵势甚大，难以对敌，就率领七百拿刀的兵，要冲过阵去到以东王那里，却是不能；
3.en: When the king of Moab saw that the battle was too severe for him, he took with him seven hundred men who drew a sword, to break through to the king of Edom; but they could not.

3.zh: 便将那应当接续他作王的长子，在城上献为燔祭。以色列人遭遇[耶和华的]大怒，于是三王离开摩押王，各回本国去了。
3.en: Then he took his oldest son who would have reigned in his place, and offered him for a burnt offering on the wall. There was great wrath against Israel; and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.

4.zh: 有一个先知门徒的妻哀求以利沙说：「你仆人—我丈夫死了，他敬畏耶和华是你所知道的。现在有债主来，要取我两个儿子作奴仆。」
4.en: Now a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha, saying, “Your servant my husband is dead. You know that your servant feared the LORD. Now the creditor has come to take for himself my two children to be slaves.”

4.zh: 以利沙问她说：「我可以为你做什么呢？你告诉我，你家里有什么？」她说：「婢女家中除了一瓶油之外，没有什么。」
4.en: Elisha said to her, “What should I do for you? Tell me, what do you have in the house?” She said, “Your servant has nothing in the house, except a pot of oil.”

4.zh: 以利沙说：「你去，向你众邻舍借空器皿，不要少借；
4.en: Then he said, “Go, borrow empty containers from all your neighbors. Don’t borrow just a few containers.

4.zh: 回到家里，关上门，你和你儿子在里面将油倒在所有的器皿里，倒满了的放在一边。」
4.en: Go in and shut the door on you and on your sons, and pour oil into all those containers; and set aside those which are full.”

4.zh: 于是，妇人离开以利沙去了，关上门，自己和儿子在里面；儿子把[器皿]拿来，她就倒油。
4.en: So she went from him, and shut the door on herself and on her sons. They brought the containers to her, and she poured oil.

4.zh: 器皿都满了，她对儿子说：「再给我拿器皿来。」儿子说：「再没有器皿了。」油就止住了。
4.en: When the containers were full, she said to her son, “Bring me another container.” He said to her, “There isn’t another container.” Then the oil stopped flowing.

4.zh: 妇人去告诉神人，神人说：「你去卖油还债，所剩的你和你儿子可以靠着度日。」
4.en: Then she came and told the man of God. He said, “Go, sell the oil, and pay your debt; and you and your sons live on the rest.”

4.zh: 一日，以利沙走到书念，在那里有一个大户的妇人强留他吃饭。此后，以利沙每从那里经过就进去吃饭。
4.en: One day Elisha went to Shunem, where there was a prominent woman; and she persuaded him to eat bread. So it was, that as often as he passed by, he turned in there to eat bread.

4.zh: 妇人对丈夫说：「我看出那常从我们这里经过的是圣洁的神人。
4.en: She said to her husband, “See now, I perceive that this is a holy man of God who passes by us continually.

4.zh: 我们可以为他在墙上盖一间小楼，在其中安放床榻、桌子、椅子、灯台，他来到我们这里，就可以住在其间。」
4.en: Please, let’s make a little room on the roof. Let’s set a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp stand for him there. When he comes to us, he can stay there.”

4.zh: 一日，以利沙来到那里，就进了那楼躺卧。
4.en: One day he came there, and he went to the room and lay there.

4.zh: 以利沙吩咐仆人基哈西说：「你叫这书念妇人来。」他就把妇人叫了来，妇人站在以利沙面前。
4.en: He said to Gehazi his servant, “Call this Shunammite.” When he had called her, she stood before him.

4.zh: 以利沙吩咐仆人说：「你对她说：你既为我们费了许多心思，可以为你做什么呢？你向王或元帅有所求的没有？」她回答说：「我在我本乡安居无事。」
4.en: He said to him, “Say now to her, ‘Behold, you have cared for us with all this care. What is to be done for you? Would you like to be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the army?’” She answered, “I dwell among my own people.”

4.zh: 以利沙[对仆人]说：「究竟当为她做什么呢？」基哈西说：「她没有儿子，她丈夫也老了。」
4.en: He said, “What then is to be done for her?” Gehazi answered, “Most certainly she has no son, and her husband is old.”

4.zh: 以利沙说：「再叫她来。」于是叫了她来，她就站在门口。
4.en: He said, “Call her.” When he had called her, she stood in the door.

4.zh: 以利沙说：「明年到这时候，你必抱一个儿子。」她说：「神人，我主啊，不要那样欺哄婢女。」
4.en: He said, “At this season next year, you will embrace a son.” She said, “No, my lord, you man of God, do not lie to your servant.”

4.zh: 妇人果然怀孕，到了那时候，生了一个儿子，正如以利沙所说的。
4.en: The woman conceived, and bore a son at that season when the time came around, as Elisha had said to her.

4.zh: 孩子渐渐长大，一日到他父亲和收割的人那里，
4.en: When the child was grown, one day he went out to his father to the reapers.

4.zh: 他对父亲说：「我的头啊，我的头啊！」他父亲对仆人说：「把他抱到他母亲那里。」
4.en: He said to his father, “My head! My head!” He said to his servant, “Carry him to his mother.”

4.zh: 仆人抱去，交给他母亲；孩子坐在母亲的膝上，到晌午就死了。
4.en: When he had taken him and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees until noon, and then died.

4.zh: 他母亲抱他上了楼，将他放在神人的床上，关上[门]出来，
4.en: She went up and laid him on the man of God’s bed, and shut the door on him, and went out.

4.zh: 呼叫她丈夫说：「你叫一个仆人给我牵一匹驴来，我要快快地去见神人，就回来。」
4.en: She called to her husband and said, “Please send me one of the servants, and one of the donkeys, that I may run to the man of God and come again.”

4.zh: 丈夫说：「今日不是月朔，也不是安息日，你为何要去见他呢？」妇人说：「平安无事。」
4.en: He said, “Why would you want to go to him today? It is not a new moon or a Sabbath.” She said, “It’s all right.”

4.zh: 于是备上驴，对仆人说：「你快快赶着走，我若不吩咐你，就不要迟慢。」
4.en: Then she saddled a donkey, and said to her servant, “Drive, and go forward! Don’t slow down for me, unless I ask you to.”

4.zh: 妇人就往迦密山去见神人。 神人远远地看见她，对仆人基哈西说：「看哪，书念的妇人来了！
4.en: So she went, and came to the man of God to Mount Carmel. When the man of God saw her afar off, he said to Gehazi his servant, “Behold, there is the Shunammite.

4.zh: 你跑去迎接她，问她说：你平安吗？你丈夫平安吗？孩子平安吗？」她说：「平安。」
4.en: Please run now to meet her, and ask her, ‘Is it well with you? Is it well with your husband? Is it well with your child?’” She answered, “It is well.”

4.zh: 妇人上了山，到神人那里，就抱住神人的脚。基哈西前来要推开她，神人说：「由她吧！因为她心里愁苦，耶和华向我隐瞒，没有指示我。」
4.en: When she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught hold of his feet. Gehazi came near to thrust her away; but the man of God said, “Leave her alone, for her soul is troubled within her; and the LORD has hidden it from me, and has not told me.”

4.zh: 妇人说：「我何尝向我主求过儿子呢？我岂没有说过，不要欺哄我吗？」
4.en: Then she said, “Did I ask you for a son, my lord? Didn’t I say, ‘Do not deceive me’?”

4.zh: 以利沙吩咐基哈西说：「你束上腰，手拿我的杖前去；若遇见人，不要向他问安；人若向你问安，也不要回答；要把我的杖放在孩子脸上。」
4.en: Then he said to Gehazi, “Tuck your cloak into your belt, take my staff in your hand, and go your way. If you meet any man, don’t greet him; and if anyone greets you, don’t answer him again. Then lay my staff on the child’s face.”

4.zh: 孩子的母亲说：「我指着永生的耶和华，又敢在你面前起誓，我必不离开你。」于是以利沙起身，随着她去了。
4.en: The child’s mother said, “As the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So he arose, and followed her.

4.zh: 基哈西先去，把杖放在孩子脸上，却没有声音，也没有动静。基哈西就迎着以利沙回来，告诉他说：「孩子还没有醒过来。」
4.en: Gehazi went ahead of them, and laid the staff on the child’s face; but there was no voice and no hearing. Therefore he returned to meet him, and told him, “The child has not awakened.”

4.zh: 以利沙来到，进了屋子，看见孩子死了，放在自己的床上。
4.en: When Elisha had come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and lying on his bed.

4.zh: 他就关上门，只有自己和孩子在里面，他便祈祷耶和华，
4.en: He went in therefore, and shut the door on them both, and prayed to the LORD.

4.zh: 上床伏在孩子身上，口对口，眼对眼，手对手；既伏在孩子身上，孩子的身体就渐渐温和了。
4.en: He went up and lay on the child, and put his mouth on his mouth, and his eyes on his eyes, and his hands on his hands. He stretched himself on him; and the child’s flesh grew warm.

4.zh: 然后他下来，在屋里来往走了一趟，又上去伏在孩子身上，孩子打了七个喷嚏，就睁开眼睛了。
4.en: Then he returned, and walked in the house once back and forth, then went up and stretched himself out on him. Then the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.

4.zh: 以利沙叫基哈西说：「你叫这书念妇人来」；于是叫了她来。以利沙说：「将你儿子抱起来。」
4.en: He called Gehazi, and said, “Call this Shunammite!” So he called her. When she had come in to him, he said, “Take up your son.”

4.zh: 妇人就进来，在以利沙脚前俯伏于地，抱起她儿子出去了。
4.en: Then she went in, fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground; then she picked up her son, and went out.

4.zh: 以利沙又来到吉甲，那地正有饥荒。先知门徒坐在他面前，他吩咐仆人说：「你将大锅放在火上，给先知门徒熬汤。」
4.en: Elisha came again to Gilgal. There was a famine in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him; and he said to his servant, “Get the large pot, and boil stew for the sons of the prophets.”

4.zh: 有一个人去到田野掐菜，遇见一棵野瓜藤，就摘了一兜野瓜回来，切了搁在熬汤的锅中，因为他们不知道是什么东西；
4.en: One went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered a lap full of wild gourds from it, and came and cut them up into the pot of stew; for they didn’t recognize them.

4.zh: 倒出来给众人吃，吃的时候，都喊叫说：「神人哪，锅中有致死的毒物！」所以众人不能吃了。
4.en: So they poured out for the men to eat. As they were eating some of the stew, they cried out and said, “Man of God, there is death in the pot!” And they could not eat it.

4.zh: 以利沙说：「拿点面来」，就把面撒在锅中，说：「倒出来，给众人吃吧！」锅中就没有毒了。
4.en: But he said, “Then bring meal.” He threw it into the pot; and he said, “Serve it to the people, that they may eat.” And there was nothing harmful in the pot.

4.zh: 有一个人从巴力·沙利沙来，带着初熟大麦做的饼二十个，并新穗子，装在口袋里送给神人。神人说：「把这些给众人吃。」
4.en: A man from Baal Shalishah came, and brought the man of God some bread of the first fruits: twenty loaves of barley and fresh ears of grain in his sack. Elisha said, “Give to the people, that they may eat.”

4.zh: 仆人说：「这一点岂可摆给一百人吃呢？」以利沙说：「你只管给众人吃吧！因为耶和华如此说，众人必吃了，还剩下。」
4.en: His servant said, “What, should I set this before a hundred men?” But he said, “Give it to the people, that they may eat; for the LORD says, ‘They will eat, and will have some left over.’”

4.zh: 仆人就摆在众人面前，他们吃了，果然还剩下，正如耶和华所说的。
4.en: So he set it before them and they ate and had some left over, according to the LORD’s word.

5.zh: 亚兰王的元帅乃缦在他主人面前为尊为大，因耶和华曾借他使亚兰人得胜；他又是大能的勇士，只是长了大麻风。
5.en: Now Naaman, captain of the army of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honorable, because by him the LORD had given victory to Syria; he was also a mighty man of valor, but he was a leper.

5.zh: 先前亚兰人成群地出去，从以色列国掳了一个小女子，这女子就服事乃缦的妻。
5.en: The Syrians had gone out in bands, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little girl, and she waited on Naaman’s wife.

5.zh: 她对主母说：「巴不得我主人去见撒马利亚的先知，必能治好他的大麻风。」
5.en: She said to her mistress, “I wish that my lord were with the prophet who is in Samaria! Then he would heal him of his leprosy.”

5.zh: 乃缦进去，告诉他主人说，以色列国的女子如此如此说。
5.en: Someone went in and told his lord, saying, “The girl who is from the land of Israel said this.”

5.zh: 亚兰王说：「你可以去，我也达信于以色列王。」于是乃缦带银子十他连得，金子六千[舍客勒]，衣裳十套，就去了；
5.en: The king of Syria said, “Go now, and I will send a letter to the king of Israel.” He departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of clothing.

5.zh: 且带信给以色列王，信上说：「我打发臣仆乃缦去见你，你接到这信，就要治好他的大麻风。」
5.en: He brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, “Now when this letter has come to you, behold, I have sent Naaman my servant to you, that you may heal him of his leprosy.”

5.zh: 以色列王看了信就撕裂衣服，说：「我岂是　神，能使人死使人活呢？这人竟打发人来，叫我治好他的大麻风。你们看一看，这人何以寻隙攻击我呢？」
5.en: When the king of Israel had read the letter, he tore his clothes and said, “Am I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man sends to me to heal a man of his leprosy? But please consider and see how he seeks a quarrel against me.”

5.zh: 神人以利沙听见以色列王撕裂衣服，就打发人去见王，说：「你为什么撕了衣服呢？可使那人到我这里来，他就知道以色列中有先知了。」
5.en: It was so, when Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had torn his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, “Why have you torn your clothes? Let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.”

5.zh: 于是，乃缦带着车马到了以利沙的家，站在门前。
5.en: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariots, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.

5.zh: 以利沙打发一个使者，对乃缦说：「你去在约旦河中沐浴七回，你的肉就必复原，而得洁净。」
5.en: Elisha sent a messenger to him, saying, “Go and wash in the Jordan seven times, and your flesh shall come again to you, and you shall be clean.”

5.zh: 乃缦却发怒走了，说：「我想他必定出来见我，站着求告耶和华—他　神的名，在患处以上摇手，治好这大麻风。
5.en: But Naaman was angry, and went away and said, “Behold, I thought, ‘He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the LORD his God, and wave his hand over the place, and heal the leper.’

5.zh: 大马士革的河亚罢拿和法珥法岂不比以色列的一切水更好吗？我在那里沐浴不得洁净吗？」于是气忿忿地转身去了。
5.en: Aren’t Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Couldn’t I wash in them and be clean?” So he turned and went away in a rage.

5.zh: 他的仆人进前来，对他说：「我父啊，先知若吩咐你做一件大事，你岂不做吗？何况说你去沐浴而得洁净呢？」
5.en: His servants came near and spoke to him, and said, “My father, if the prophet had asked you do some great thing, wouldn’t you have done it? How much rather then, when he says to you, ‘Wash, and be clean’?”

5.zh: 于是乃缦下去，照着神人的话，在约旦河里沐浴七回；他的肉复原，好像小孩子的肉，他就洁净了。
5.en: Then went he down and dipped himself seven times in the Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God; and his flesh was restored like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

5.zh: 乃缦带着一切跟随他的人，回到神人那里，站在他面前，说：「如今我知道，除了以色列之外，普天下没有　神。现在求你收点仆人的礼物。」
5.en: He returned to the man of God, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him; and he said, “See now, I know that there is no God in all the earth, but in Israel. Now therefore, please take a gift from your servant.”

5.zh: 以利沙说：「我指着所事奉永生的耶和华起誓，我必不受。」乃缦再三地求他，他却不受。
5.en: But he said, “As the LORD lives, before whom I stand, I will receive none.” He urged him to take it; but he refused.

5.zh: 乃缦说：「你若不肯受，请将两骡子驮的土赐给仆人。从今以后，仆人必不再将燔祭或[平安]祭献与别神，只献给耶和华。
5.en: Naaman said, “If not, then, please let two mules’ load of earth be given to your servant; for your servant will from now on offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice to other gods, but to the LORD.

5.zh: 惟有一件事，愿耶和华饶恕你仆人：我主人进临门庙叩拜的时候，我用手搀他在临门庙，我也屈身。我在临门庙屈身的这事，愿耶和华饶恕我。」
5.en: In this thing may the LORD pardon your servant: when my master goes into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leans on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon. When I bow myself in the house of Rimmon, may the LORD pardon your servant in this thing.”

5.zh: 以利沙对他说：「你可以平平安安地回去！」 乃缦就离开他去了；走了不远，
5.en: He said to him, “Go in peace.” So he departed from him a little way.

5.zh: 神人以利沙的仆人基哈西[心里]说：「我主人不愿从这亚兰人乃缦手里受他带来的礼物，我指着永生的耶和华起誓，我必跑去追上他，向他要些。」
5.en: But Gehazi the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, “Behold, my master has spared this Naaman the Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought. As the LORD lives, I will run after him, and take something from him.”

5.zh: 于是基哈西追赶乃缦。乃缦看见有人追赶，就急忙下车迎着他，说：「都平安吗？」
5.en: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. When Naaman saw one running after him, he came down from the chariot to meet him, and said, “Is all well?”

5.zh: 说：「都平安。我主人打发我来说：『刚才有两个少年人，是先知门徒，从以法莲山地来见我，请你赐他们一他连得银子，两套衣裳。』」
5.en: He said, “All is well. My master has sent me, saying, ‘Behold, even now two young men of the sons of the prophets have come to me from the hill country of Ephraim. Please give them a talent of silver and two changes of clothing.’”

5.zh: 乃缦说：「请受二他连得」；再三地请受，便将二他连得银子装在两个口袋里，又将两套衣裳交给两个仆人；他们就在基哈西前头抬着走。
5.en: Naaman said, “Be pleased to take two talents.” He urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of clothing, and laid them on two of his servants; and they carried them before him.

5.zh: 到了山冈，基哈西从他们手中接过来，放在屋里，打发他们回去。
5.en: When he came to the hill, he took them from their hand, and stored them in the house. Then he let the men go, and they departed.

5.zh: 基哈西进去，站在他主人面前。以利沙问他说：「基哈西你从哪里来？」回答说：「仆人没有往哪里去。」
5.en: But he went in, and stood before his master. Elisha said to him, “Where did you come from, Gehazi?” He said, “Your servant went nowhere.”

5.zh: 以利沙对他说：「那人下车转回迎你的时候，我的心岂没有去呢？这岂是受银子、衣裳、[买]橄榄园、葡萄园、牛羊、仆婢的时候呢？
5.en: He said to him, “Didn’t my heart go with you when the man turned from his chariot to meet you? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and olive groves and vineyards, and sheep and cattle, and male servants and female servants?

5.zh: 因此，乃缦的大麻风必沾染你和你的后裔，直到永远。」基哈西从以利沙面前退出去，就长了大麻风，像雪[那样白]。
5.en: Therefore the leprosy of Naaman will cling to you and to your offspring forever.” He went out from his presence a leper, as white as snow.

6.zh: 先知门徒对以利沙说：「看哪，我们同你所住的地方过于窄小，
6.en: The sons of the prophets said to Elisha, “See now, the place where we live and meet with you is too small for us.

6.zh: 求你容我们往约旦河去，各人从那里取一根木料建造房屋居住。」他说：「你们去吧！」
6.en: Please let us go to the Jordan, and each man take a beam from there, and let’s make us a place there, where we may live.” He answered, “Go!”

6.zh: 有一人说：「求你与仆人同去。」回答说：「我可以去。」
6.en: One said, “Please be pleased to go with your servants.” He answered, “I will go.”

6.zh: 于是以利沙与他们同去。到了约旦河，就砍伐树木。
6.en: So he went with them. When they came to the Jordan, they cut down wood.

6.zh: 有一人砍树的时候，斧头掉在水里，他就呼叫说：「哀哉！我主啊，这斧子是借的。」
6.en: But as one was cutting down a tree, the ax head fell into the water. Then he cried out and said, “Alas, my master! For it was borrowed.”

6.zh: 神人问说：「掉在哪里了？」他将那地方指给以利沙看。以利沙砍了一根木头，抛在水里，斧头就漂上来了。
6.en: The man of God asked, “Where did it fall?” He showed him the place. He cut down a stick, threw it in there, and made the iron float.

6.zh: 以利沙说：「拿起来吧！」那人就伸手拿起来了。
6.en: He said, “Take it.” So he put out his hand and took it.

6.zh: 亚兰王与以色列人争战，和他的臣仆商议说：「我要在某处某处安营。」
6.en: Now the king of Syria was at war against Israel; and he took counsel with his servants, saying, “My camp will be in such and such a place.”

6.zh: 神人打发人去见以色列王，说：「你要谨慎，不要从某处经过，因为亚兰人从那里下来了。」
6.en: The man of God sent to the king of Israel, saying, “Beware that you not pass this place, for the Syrians are coming down there.”

6.zh: 以色列王差人去[窥探]神人所告诉所警戒他去的地方，就防备未受其害，不止一两次。
6.en: The king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of; and he saved himself there, not once or twice.

6.zh: 亚兰王因这事心里惊疑，召了臣仆来，对他们说：「我们这里有谁帮助以色列王，你们不指给我吗？」
6.en: The king of Syria’s heart was very troubled about this. He called his servants, and said to them, “Won’t you show me which of us is for the king of Israel?”

6.zh: 有一个臣仆说：「我主，我王！无人帮助他，只有以色列中的先知以利沙，将王在卧房所说的话告诉以色列王了。」
6.en: One of his servants said, “No, my lord, O king; but Elisha, the prophet who is in Israel, tells the king of Israel the words that you speak in your bedroom.”

6.zh: 王说：「你们去探他在哪里，我好打发人去捉拿他。」有人告诉王说：「他在多坍。」
6.en: He said, “Go and see where he is, that I may send and get him.” He was told, “Behold, he is in Dothan.”

6.zh: 王就打发车马和大军往那里去，夜间到了，围困那城。
6.en: Therefore he sent horses, chariots, and a great army there. They came by night and surrounded the city.

6.zh: 神人的仆人清早起来出去，看见车马军兵围困了城。仆人对神人说：「哀哉！我主啊，我们怎样行才好呢？」
6.en: When the servant of the man of God had risen early and gone out, behold, an army with horses and chariots was around the city. His servant said to him, “Alas, my master! What shall we do?”

6.zh: 神人说：「不要惧怕！与我们同在的比与他们同在的更多。」
6.en: He answered, “Don’t be afraid, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”

6.zh: 以利沙祷告说：「耶和华啊，求你开这少年人的眼目，使他能看见。」耶和华开他的眼目，他就看见满山有火车火马围绕以利沙。
6.en: Elisha prayed, and said, “LORD, please open his eyes, that he may see.” the LORD opened the young man’s eyes, and he saw; and behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire around Elisha.

6.zh: 敌人下到以利沙那里，以利沙祷告耶和华说：「求你使这些人的眼目昏迷。」耶和华就照以利沙的话，使他们的眼目昏迷。
6.en: When they came down to him, Elisha prayed to the LORD, and said, “Please strike this people with blindness.” He struck them with blindness according to Elisha’s word.

6.zh: 以利沙对他们说：「这不是那道，也不是那城；你们跟我去，我必领你们到所寻找的人那里。」于是领他们到了撒马利亚。
6.en: Elisha said to them, “This is not the way, neither is this the city. Follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom you seek.” He led them to Samaria.

6.zh: 他们进了撒马利亚，以利沙[祷告]说：「耶和华啊，求你开这些人的眼目，使他们能看见。」耶和华开他们的眼目，他们就看见了，不料，是在撒马利亚的城中。
6.en: When they had come into Samaria, Elisha said, “LORD, open these men’s eyes, that they may see.” The LORD opened their eyes, and they saw; and behold, they were in the middle of Samaria.

6.zh: 以色列王见了他们，就问以利沙说：「我父啊，我可以击杀他们吗？」
6.en: The king of Israel said to Elisha, when he saw them, “My father, shall I strike them? Shall I strike them?”

6.zh: 回答说：「不可击杀他们！就是你用刀用弓掳来的，岂可击杀他们吗？当在他们面前设摆饮食，使他们吃喝回到他们的主人那里。」
6.en: He answered, “You shall not strike them. Would you strike those whom you have taken captive with your sword and with your bow? Set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, then go to their master.”

6.zh: 王就为他们预备了许多食物；他们吃喝完了，打发他们回到他们主人那里。从此，亚兰军不再犯以色列境了。
6.en: He prepared a great feast for them. After they ate and drank, he sent them away and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria stopped raiding the land of Israel.

6.zh: 此后，亚兰王便·哈达聚集他的全军，上来围困撒马利亚。
6.en: After this, Benhadad king of Syria gathered all his army, and went up and besieged Samaria.

6.zh: 于是撒马利亚被围困，有饥荒，甚至一个驴头值银八十[舍客勒]，二升鸽子粪值银五[舍客勒]。
6.en: There was a great famine in Samaria. Behold, they besieged it until a donkey’s head was sold for eighty pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a kab of dove’s dung for five pieces of silver.

6.zh: 一日，以色列王在城上经过，有一个妇人向他呼叫说：「我主，我王啊！求你帮助。」
6.en: As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried to him, saying, “Help, my lord, O king!”

6.zh: 王说：「耶和华不帮助你，我从何处帮助你？是从禾场，是从酒榨呢？」
6.en: He said, “If the LORD doesn’t help you, where could I get help for you? From the threshing floor, or from the wine press?”

6.zh: 王问妇人说：「你有什么苦处？」她回答说：「这妇人对我说：『将你的儿子取来，我们今日可以吃，明日可以吃我的儿子。』
6.en: Then the king asked her, “What is your problem?” She answered, “This woman said to me, ‘Give your son, that we may eat him today, and we will eat my son tomorrow.’

6.zh: 我们就煮了我的儿子吃了。次日我对她说：『要将你的儿子取来，我们可以吃。』她却将她的儿子藏起来了。」
6.en: So we boiled my son and ate him; and I said to her on the next day, ‘Give up your son, that we may eat him;’ and she has hidden her son.”

6.zh: 王听见妇人的话，就撕裂衣服；（王在城上经过）百姓看见王贴身穿着麻衣。
6.en: When the king heard the words of the woman, he tore his clothes. Now he was passing by on the wall, and the people looked, and behold, he had sackcloth underneath on his body.

6.zh: 王说：「我今日若容沙法的儿子以利沙的头仍在他项上，愿　神重重地降罚与我！」
6.en: Then he said, “God do so to me, and more also, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat stays on him today.”

6.zh: 那时，以利沙正坐在家中，长老也与他同坐。[王]打发一个伺候他的人去；他还没有到，以利沙对长老说：「你们看这凶手之子，打发人来斩我的头；你们看着使者来到，就关上门，用门将他推出去。在他后头不是有他主人脚步的响声吗？」
6.en: But Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him. Then the king sent a man from before him; but before the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, “Do you see how this son of a murderer has sent to take away my head? Behold, when the messenger comes, shut the door, and hold the door shut against him. Isn’t the sound of his master’s feet behind him?”

6.zh: 正说话的时候，使者来到，[王也到了]，说：「这灾祸是从耶和华那里来的，我何必再仰望耶和华呢？」
6.en: While he was still talking with them, behold, the messenger came down to him. Then he said, “Behold, this evil is from the LORD. Why should I wait for the LORD any longer?”

7.zh: 以利沙说：「你们要听耶和华的话，耶和华如此说：明日约到这时候，在撒马利亚城门口，一细亚细面要[卖]银一舍客勒，二细亚大麦也要[卖]银一舍客勒。」
7.en: Elisha said, “Hear the LORD’s word. The LORD says, ‘Tomorrow about this time a seah of fine flour will be sold for a shekel, and two seahs of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.’”

7.zh: 有一个搀扶王的军长对神人说：「即便耶和华使天开了窗户，也不能有这事。」以利沙说：「你必亲眼看见，却不得吃。」
7.en: Then the captain on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God, and said, “Behold, if the LORD made windows in heaven, could this thing be?” He said, “Behold, you will see it with your eyes, but will not eat of it.”

7.zh: 在城门那里有四个长大麻风的人，他们彼此说：「我们为何坐在这里等死呢？
7.en: Now there were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate. They said to one another, “Why do we sit here until we die?

7.zh: 我们若说，进城去吧！城里有饥荒，必死在那里；若在这里坐着不动，也必是死。来吧，我们去投降亚兰人的军队，他们若留我们的活命，就活着；若杀我们，就死了吧！」
7.en: If we say, ‘We will enter into the city,’ then the famine is in the city, and we will die there. If we sit still here, we also die. Now therefore come, and let’s surrender to the army of the Syrians. If they save us alive, we will live; and if they kill us, we will only die.”

7.zh: 黄昏的时候，他们起来往亚兰人的营盘去；到了营边，不见一人在那里。
7.en: They rose up in the twilight to go to the camp of the Syrians. When they had come to the outermost part of the camp of the Syrians, behold, no man was there.

7.zh: 因为主使亚兰人的军队听见车马的声音，是大军的声音；他们就彼此说：「这必是以色列王贿买赫人的诸王和埃及人的诸王来攻击我们。」
7.en: For the Lord had made the army of the Syrians to hear the sound of chariots and the sound of horses, even the noise of a great army; and they said to one another, “Behold, the king of Israel has hired against us the kings of the Hittites and the kings of the Egyptians to attack us.”

7.zh: 所以，在黄昏的时候他们起来逃跑，撇下帐棚、马、驴，营盘照旧，只顾逃命。
7.en: Therefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, their horses, and their donkeys, even the camp as it was, and fled for their life.

7.zh: 那些长大麻风的到了营边，进了帐棚，吃了喝了，且从其中拿出金银和衣服来，去收藏了；回来又进了一座帐棚，从其中拿出财物来去收藏了。
7.en: When these lepers came to the outermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and ate and drank, then carried away silver, gold, and clothing and went and hid it. Then they came back, and entered into another tent and carried things from there also, and went and hid them.

7.zh: 那时，他们彼此说：「我们所做的不好！今日是有好信息的日子，我们竟不作声！若等到天亮，罪必临到我们。来吧，我们与王家报信去！」
7.en: Then they said to one another, “We aren’t doing right. Today is a day of good news, and we keep silent. If we wait until the morning light, punishment will overtake us. Now therefore come, let’s go and tell the king’s household.”

7.zh: 他们就去叫守城门的，告诉他们说：「我们到了亚兰人的营，不见一人在那里，也无人声，只有拴着的马和驴，帐棚都照旧。」
7.en: So they came and called to the city gatekeepers; and they told them, “We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, not even a man’s voice, but the horses tied, and the donkeys tied, and the tents as they were.”

7.zh: 守城门的叫了众守门的人来，他们就进去与王家报信。
7.en: Then the gatekeepers called out and told it to the king’s household within.

7.zh: 王夜间起来，对臣仆说：「我告诉你们亚兰人向我们如何行。他们知道我们饥饿，所以离营，埋伏在田野，说：『以色列人出城的时候，我们就活捉他们，得以进城。』」
7.en: The king arose in the night, and said to his servants, “I will now show you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we are hungry. Therefore they have gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, ‘When they come out of the city, we shall take them alive, and get into the city.’”

7.zh: 有一个臣仆对王说：「我们不如用城里剩下之马中的五匹马（马和城里剩下的以色列人都是一样，快要灭绝），打发人去窥探。」
7.en: One of his servants answered, “Please let some people take five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are left in it. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are consumed. Let’s send and see.”

7.zh: 于是取了两辆车和马，王差人去追寻亚兰军，说：「你们去窥探窥探。」
7.en: Therefore they took two chariots with horses; and the king sent them out to the Syrian army, saying, “Go and see.”

7.zh: 他们就追寻到约旦河，看见满道上都是亚兰人急跑时丢弃的衣服器具，使者就回来报告王。
7.en: They went after them to the Jordan; and behold, all the path was full of garments and equipment which the Syrians had cast away in their haste. The messengers returned and told the king.

7.zh: 众人就出去，掳掠亚兰人的营盘。于是一细亚细面[卖]银一舍客勒，二细亚大麦也[卖]银一舍客勒，正如耶和华所说的。
7.en: The people went out and plundered the camp of the Syrians. So a seah of fine flour was sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, according to the LORD’s word.

7.zh: 王派搀扶他的那军长在城门口弹压，众人在那里将他践踏，他就死了，正如神人在王下来见他的时候所说的。
7.en: The king had appointed the captain on whose hand he leaned to be in charge of the gate; and the people trampled over him in the gate, and he died as the man of God had said, who spoke when the king came down to him.

7.zh: 神人曾对王说：「明日约到这时候，在撒马利亚城门口，二细亚大麦要[卖]银一舍客勒，一细亚细面也要[卖]银一舍客勒。」
7.en: It happened as the man of God had spoken to the king, saying, “Two seahs of barley for a shekel, and a seah of fine flour for a shekel, shall be tomorrow about this time in the gate of Samaria;”

7.zh: 那军长对神人说：「即便耶和华使天开了窗户，也不能有这事。」神人说：「你必亲眼看见，却不得吃。」
7.en: and that captain answered the man of God, and said, “Now, behold, if the LORD made windows in heaven, might such a thing be?” and he said, “Behold, you will see it with your eyes, but will not eat of it.”

7.zh: 这话果然应验在他身上；因为众人在城门口将他践踏，他就死了。
7.en: It happened like that to him, for the people trampled over him in the gate, and he died.

8.zh: 以利沙曾对所救活之子的那妇人说：「你和你的全家要起身往你可住的地方去住，因为耶和华命饥荒降在这地七年。」
8.en: Now Elisha had spoken to the woman whose son he had restored to life, saying, “Arise, and go, you and your household, and stay for a while wherever you can; for the LORD has called for a famine. It will also come on the land for seven years.”

8.zh: 妇人就起身，照神人的话带着全家往非利士地去，住了七年。
8.en: The woman arose, and did according to the man of God’s word. She went with her household, and lived in the land of the Philistines for seven years.

8.zh: 七年完了，那妇人从非利士地回来，就出去为自己的房屋田地哀告王。
8.en: At the end of seven years, the woman returned from the land of the Philistines. Then she went out to beg the king for her house and for her land.

8.zh: 那时王正与神人的仆人基哈西说：「请你将以利沙所行的一切大事告诉我。」
8.en: Now the king was talking with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, “Please tell me all the great things that Elisha has done.”

8.zh: 基哈西告诉王以利沙如何使死人复活，恰巧以利沙所救活、她儿子的那妇人为自己的房屋田地来哀告王。基哈西说：「我主我王，这就是那妇人，这是她的儿子，就是以利沙所救活的。」
8.en: As he was telling the king how he had restored to life him who was dead, behold, the woman whose son he had restored to life begged the king for her house and for her land. Gehazi said, “My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.”

8.zh: 王问那妇人，她就把那事告诉王。于是王为她派一个太监，说：「凡属这妇人的都还给她，自从她离开本地直到今日，她田地的出产也都还给她。」
8.en: When the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed to her a certain officer, saying, “Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.”

8.zh: 以利沙来到大马士革，亚兰王便·哈达正患病。有人告诉王说：「神人来到这里了。」
8.en: Elisha came to Damascus; and Benhadad the king of Syria was sick. He was told, “The man of God has come here.”

8.zh: 王就吩咐哈薛说：「你带着礼物去见神人，托他求问耶和华，我这病能好不能好？」
8.en: The king said to Hazael, “Take a present in your hand, and go meet the man of God, and inquire of the LORD by him, saying, ‘Will I recover from this sickness?’”

8.zh: 于是哈薛用四十个骆驼，驮着大马士革的各样美物为礼物，去见以利沙。到了他那里，站在他面前，说：「你儿子亚兰王便·哈达打发我来见你，他问说：『我这病能好不能好？』」
8.en: So Hazael went to meet him and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels’ burden, and came and stood before him and said, “Your son Benhadad king of Syria has sent me to you, saying, ‘Will I recover from this sickness?’”

8.zh: 以利沙对哈薛说：「你回去告诉他说，这病必能好；但耶和华指示我，他必要死。」
8.en: Elisha said to him, “Go, tell him, ‘You will surely recover;’ however the LORD has shown me that he will surely die.”

8.zh: 神人定睛看着哈薛，甚至他惭愧。神人就哭了；
8.en: He settled his gaze steadfastly on him, until he was ashamed. Then the man of God wept.

8.zh: 哈薛说：「我主为什么哭？」回答说：「因为我知道你必苦害以色列人，用火焚烧他们的保障，用刀杀死他们的壮丁，摔死他们的婴孩，剖开他们的孕妇。」
8.en: Hazael said, “Why do you weep, my lord?” He answered, “Because I know the evil that you will do to the children of Israel. You will set their strongholds on fire, and you will kill their young men with the sword, and will dash their little ones in pieces, and rip up their pregnant women.”

8.zh: 哈薛说：「你仆人算什么，不过是一条狗，焉能行这大事呢？」以利沙回答说：「耶和华指示我，你必作亚兰王。」
8.en: Hazael said, “But what is your servant, who is but a dog, that he could do this great thing?” Elisha answered, “The LORD has shown me that you will be king over Syria.”

8.zh: 哈薛离开以利沙，回去见他的主人。主人问他说：「以利沙对你说什么？」回答说：「他告诉我你必能好。」
8.en: Then he departed from Elisha, and came to his master, who said to him, “What did Elisha say to you?” He answered, “He told me that you would surely recover.”

8.zh: 次日，哈薛拿被窝浸在水中，蒙住王的脸，王就死了。于是哈薛篡了他的位。
8.en: On the next day, he took a thick cloth, dipped it in water, and spread it on the king’s face, so that he died. Then Hazael reigned in his place.

8.zh: 以色列王亚哈的儿子约兰第五年，犹大王约沙法还在位的时候，约沙法的儿子约兰登基作了犹大王。
8.en: In the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat being king of Judah then, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.

8.zh: 约兰登基的时候年三十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王八年。
8.en: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign. He reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

8.zh: 他行以色列诸王所行的，与亚哈家一样；因为他娶了亚哈的女儿为妻，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事。
8.en: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did Ahab’s house, for he married Ahab’s daughter. He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.

8.zh: 耶和华却因他仆人大卫的缘故，仍不肯灭绝犹大，照他所应许大卫的话，永远赐灯光与他的子孙。
8.en: However, the LORD would not destroy Judah, for David his servant’s sake, as he promised him to give to him a lamp for his children always.

8.zh: 约兰年间，以东人背叛犹大，脱离他的权下，自己立王。
8.en: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.

8.zh: 约兰率领所有的战车往撒益去，夜间起来，攻打围困他的以东人和车[兵]长；犹大兵就逃跑，各回各家去了。
8.en: Then Joram crossed over to Zair, and all his chariots with him; and he rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him with the captains of the chariots; and the people fled to their tents.

8.zh: 这样，以东人背叛犹大，脱离他的权下，直到今日。那时立拿人也背叛了。
8.en: So Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.

8.zh: 约兰其余的事，凡他所行的，都写在犹大列王记上。
8.en: The rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

8.zh: 约兰与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子亚哈谢接续他作王。
8.en: Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.

8.zh: 以色列王亚哈的儿子约兰十二年，犹大王约兰的儿子亚哈谢登基。
8.en: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign.

8.zh: 他登基的时候年二十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王一年。他母亲名叫亚她利雅，是以色列王暗利的孙女。
8.en: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri king of Israel.

8.zh: 亚哈谢效法亚哈家行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，与亚哈家一样，因为他是亚哈家的女婿。
8.en: He walked in the way of Ahab’s house and did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as did Ahab’s house, for he was the son-in-law of Ahab’s house.

8.zh: 他与亚哈的儿子约兰同往基列的拉末去，与亚兰王哈薛争战。亚兰人打伤了约兰，
8.en: He went with Joram the son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead, and the Syrians wounded Joram.

8.zh: 约兰王回到耶斯列，医治在拉末与亚兰王哈薛打仗的时候所受的伤。犹大王约兰的儿子亚哈谢因为亚哈的儿子约兰病了，就下到耶斯列看望他。
8.en: King Joram returned to be healed in Jezreel from the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. Ahaziah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.

9.zh: 先知以利沙叫了一个先知门徒来，吩咐他说：「你束上腰，手拿这瓶膏油往基列的拉末去。
9.en: Elisha the prophet called one of the sons of the prophets, and said to him, “Put your belt on your waist, take this vial of oil in your hand, and go to Ramoth Gilead.

9.zh: 到了那里，要寻找宁示的孙子、约沙法的儿子耶户，使他从同僚中起来，带他进严密的屋子，
9.en: When you come there, find Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi, and go in and make him rise up from among his brothers, and take him to an inner room.

9.zh: 将瓶里的膏油倒在他头上，说：『耶和华如此说：我膏你作以色列王。』[说完了]，就开门逃跑，不要迟延。」
9.en: Then take the vial of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, ‘The LORD says, “I have anointed you king over Israel.”’ Then open the door, flee, and don’t wait.”

9.zh: 于是那少年先知往基列的拉末去了。
9.en: So the young man, the young prophet, went to Ramoth Gilead.

9.zh: 到了那里，看见众军长都坐着，就说：「将军哪，我有话对你说。」耶户说：「我们众人里，你要对哪一个说呢？」回答说：「将军哪，我要对你说。」
9.en: When he came, behold, the captains of the army were sitting. Then he said, “I have a message for you, captain.” Jehu said, “To which one of us?” He said, “To you, O captain.”

9.zh: 耶户就起来，进了屋子，少年人将膏油倒在他头上，对他说：「耶和华—以色列的　神如此说：『我膏你作耶和华民以色列的王。
9.en: He arose, and went into the house. Then he poured the oil on his head, and said to him, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says, ‘I have anointed you king over the people of the LORD, even over Israel.

9.zh: 你要击杀你主人亚哈的全家，我好在耶洗别身上伸我仆人众先知和耶和华一切仆人流血的冤。
9.en: You must strike your master Ahab’s house, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the LORD, at the hand of Jezebel.

9.zh: 亚哈全家必都灭亡，凡属亚哈的男丁，无论是困住的、自由的，我必从以色列中剪除，
9.en: For the whole house of Ahab will perish. I will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, both him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel.

9.zh: 使亚哈的家像尼八儿子耶罗波安的家，又像亚希雅儿子巴沙的家。
9.en: I will make Ahab’s house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah.

9.zh: 耶洗别必在耶斯列田里被狗所吃，无人葬埋。』」[说完了]，少年人就开门逃跑了。
9.en: The dogs will eat Jezebel on the plot of ground of Jezreel, and there shall be no one to bury her.’” Then he opened the door and fled.

9.zh: 耶户出来，回到他主人的臣仆那里，有一人问他说：「平安吗？这狂妄的人来见你有什么事呢？」回答说：「你们认得那人，也知道他说什么。」
9.en: When Jehu came out to the servants of his lord and one said to him, “Is all well? Why did this madman come to you?” He said to them, “You know the man and how he talks.”

9.zh: 他们说：「这是假话，你据实地告诉我们。」回答说：「他如此如此对我说。他说：『耶和华如此说：我膏你作以色列王。』」
9.en: They said, “That is a lie. Tell us now.” He said, “He said to me, ‘The LORD says, I have anointed you king over Israel.’”

9.zh: 他们就急忙各将自己的衣服铺在上层台阶，使耶户坐在其上；他们吹角，说：「耶户作王了！」
9.en: Then they hurried, and each man took his cloak, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew the trumpet, saying, “Jehu is king.”

9.zh: 这样，宁示的孙子、约沙法的儿子耶户背叛约兰。先是约兰和以色列众人因为亚兰王哈薛的缘故，把守基列的拉末；
9.en: So Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi conspired against Joram. (Now Joram was defending Ramoth Gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Syria;

9.zh: 但约兰王回到耶斯列，医治与亚兰王哈薛打仗所受的伤。耶户说：「若合你们的意思，就不容人逃出城往耶斯列报信去。」
9.en: but King Joram had returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him when he fought with Hazael king of Syria.) Jehu said, “If this is your thinking, then let no one escape and go out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel.”

9.zh: 于是耶户坐车往耶斯列去，因为约兰病卧在那里。犹大王亚哈谢已经下去看望他。
9.en: So Jehu rode in a chariot and went to Jezreel, for Joram lay there. Ahaziah king of Judah had come down to see Joram.

9.zh: 有一个守望的人站在耶斯列的楼上，看见耶户带着一群人来，就说：「我看见一群人。」约兰说：「打发一个骑马的去迎接他们，问说：平安不平安？」
9.en: Now the watchman was standing on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, “I see a company.” Joram said, “Take a horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, ‘Is it peace?’”

9.zh: 骑马的就去迎接耶户，说：「王问说，平安不平安？」耶户说：「平安不平安与你何干？你转在我后头吧！」守望的人又说：「使者到了他们那里，却不回来。」
9.en: So one went on horseback to meet him, and said, “the king says, ‘Is it peace?’” Jehu said, “What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me!” The watchman said, “The messenger came to them, but he isn’t coming back.”

9.zh: 王又打发一个骑马的去。这人到了他们那里，说：「王问说，平安不平安？」耶户说：「平安不平安与你何干？你转在我后头吧！」
9.en: Then he sent out a second on horseback, who came to them and said, “The king says, ‘Is it peace?’” Jehu answered, “What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me!”

9.zh: 守望的人又说：「他到了他们那里，也不回来；车赶得甚猛，像宁示的孙子耶户的赶法。」
9.en: The watchman said, “He came to them, and isn’t coming back. The driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi, for he drives furiously.”

9.zh: 约兰吩咐说：「套车！」人就给他套车。以色列王约兰和犹大王亚哈谢各坐自己的车出去迎接耶户，在耶斯列人拿伯的田那里遇见他。
9.en: Joram said, “Get ready!” They got his chariot ready. Then Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out, each in his chariot; and they went out to meet Jehu, and found him on Naboth the Jezreelite’s land.

9.zh: 约兰见耶户就说：「耶户啊，平安吗？」耶户说：「你母亲耶洗别的淫行邪术这样多，焉能平安呢？」
9.en: When Joram saw Jehu, he said, “Is it peace, Jehu?” He answered, “What peace, so long as the prostitution of your mother Jezebel and her witchcraft abound?”

9.zh: 约兰就转车逃跑，对亚哈谢说：「亚哈谢啊，反了！」
9.en: Joram turned his hands and fled, and said to Ahaziah, “This is treason, Ahaziah!”

9.zh: 耶户开满了弓，射中约兰的脊背，箭从心窝穿出，约兰就仆倒在车上。
9.en: Jehu drew his bow with his full strength, and struck Joram between his arms; and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.

9.zh: 耶户对他的军长毕甲说：「你把他抛在耶斯列人拿伯的田间。你当追想，你我一同坐车跟随他父亚哈的时候，耶和华对亚哈所说的预言，
9.en: Then Jehu said to Bidkar his captain, “Pick him up, and throw him in the plot of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite; for remember how, when you and I rode together after Ahab his father, the LORD laid this burden on him:

9.zh: 说：『我昨日看见拿伯的血和他众子的血，我必在这块田上报应你。』这是耶和华说的，现在你要照着耶和华的话，把他抛在这田间。」
9.en: ‘Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons,’ says the LORD; ‘and I will repay you in this plot of ground,’ says the LORD. Now therefore take and cast him onto the plot of ground, according to the LORD’s word.”

9.zh: 犹大王亚哈谢见这光景，就从园亭之路逃跑。耶户追赶他，说：「把这人也杀在车上。」到了靠近以伯莲姑珥的坡上[击伤了他]。他逃到米吉多，就死在那里。
9.en: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. Jehu followed after him, and said, “Strike him also in the chariot!” They struck him at the ascent of Gur, which is by Ibleam. He fled to Megiddo, and died there.

9.zh: 他的臣仆用车将他的尸首送到耶路撒冷，葬在大卫城他自己的坟墓里，与他列祖同葬。
9.en: His servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem, and buried him in his tomb with his fathers in David’s city.

9.zh: 亚哈谢登基作犹大王的时候，是在亚哈的儿子约兰第十一年。
9.en: In the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab, Ahaziah began to reign over Judah.

9.zh: 耶户到了耶斯列；耶洗别听见就擦粉、梳头，从窗户里往外观看。
9.en: When Jehu had come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her eyes, and adorned her head, and looked out at the window.

9.zh: 耶户进门的时候，耶洗别说：「杀主人的心利啊，平安吗？」
9.en: As Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, “Do you come in peace, Zimri, you murderer of your master?”

9.zh: 耶户抬头向窗户观看，说：「谁顺从我？」有两三个太监从窗户往外看他。
9.en: He lifted up his face to the window, and said, “Who is on my side? Who?” Two or three eunuchs looked out at him.

9.zh: 耶户说：「把她扔下来！」他们就把她扔下来。她的血溅在墙上和马上；于是把她践踏了。
9.en: He said, “Throw her down!” So they threw her down; and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses. Then he trampled her under foot.

9.zh: 耶户进去，吃了喝了，吩咐说：「你们把这被咒诅的妇人葬埋了，因为她是王的女儿。」
9.en: When he had come in, he ate and drank. Then he said, “See now to this cursed woman, and bury her; for she is a king’s daughter.”

9.zh: 他们就去葬埋她，只寻得她的头骨和脚，并手掌。
9.en: They went to bury her, but they found no more of her than the skull, the feet, and the palms of her hands.

9.zh: 他们回去告诉耶户，耶户说：「这正应验耶和华借他仆人提斯比人以利亚所说的话，说：『在耶斯列田间，狗必吃耶洗别的肉；
9.en: Therefore they came back, and told him. He said, “This is the LORD’s word, which he spoke by his servant Elijah the Tishbite, saying, ‘The dogs will eat the flesh of Jezebel on the plot of Jezreel,

9.zh: 耶洗别的尸首必在耶斯列田间如同粪土，甚至人不能说这是耶洗别。』」
9.en: and the body of Jezebel will be as dung on the surface of the field on Jezreel’s land, so that they won’t say, “This is Jezebel.”’”

10.zh: 亚哈有七十个儿子在撒马利亚。耶户写信送到撒马利亚，通知耶斯列的首领，就是长老和教养亚哈[众子]的人，说：
10.en: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria, to the rulers of Jezreel, even the elders, and to those who brought up Ahab’s sons, saying,

10.zh: 「你们那里既有你们主人的众子和车马、器械、坚固城，
10.en: “Now as soon as this letter comes to you, since your master’s sons are with you, and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city also, and armor,

10.zh: 接了这信，就可以在你们主人的众子中选择一个贤能合宜的，使他坐他父亲的位，你们也可以为你们主人的家争战。」
10.en: select the best and fittest of your master’s sons, set him on his father’s throne, and fight for your master’s house.”

10.zh: 他们却甚惧怕，彼此说：「二王在他面前尚且站立不住，我们怎能站得住呢？」
10.en: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, “Behold, the two kings didn’t stand before him! How then shall we stand?”

10.zh: 家宰、邑宰，和长老，并教养[众子]的人，打发人去见耶户，说：「我们是你的仆人，凡你所吩咐我们的都必遵行，我们不立谁作王，你看怎样好就怎样行。」
10.en: He who was over the household, and he who was over the city, the elders also, and those who raised the children, sent to Jehu, saying, “We are your servants, and will do all that you ask us. We will not make any man king. You do that which is good in your eyes.”

10.zh: 耶户又给他们写信说：「你们若归顺我，听从我的话，明日这时候，要将你们主人众子的首级带到耶斯列来见我。」那时王的儿子七十人都住在教养他们那城中的尊贵人家里。
10.en: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, “If you are on my side, and if you will listen to my voice, take the heads of the men who are your master’s sons, and come to me to Jezreel by tomorrow this time.” Now the king’s sons, being seventy persons, were with the great men of the city, who brought them up.

10.zh: 信一到，他们就把王的七十个儿子杀了，将首级装在筐里，送到在耶斯列的耶户那里。
10.en: When the letter came to them, they took the king’s sons and killed them, even seventy people, and put their heads in baskets, and sent them to him to Jezreel.

10.zh: 有使者来告诉耶户说：「他们将王众子的首级送来了。」耶户说：「将首级在城门口堆作两堆，搁到明日。」
10.en: A messenger came and told him, “They have brought the heads of the king’s sons.” He said, “Lay them in two heaps at the entrance of the gate until the morning.”

10.zh: 次日早晨，耶户出来，站着对众民说：「你们都是公义的，我背叛我主人，将他杀了；这些人却是谁杀的呢？
10.en: In the morning, he went out and stood, and said to all the people, “You are righteous. Behold, I conspired against my master and killed him, but who killed all these?

10.zh: 由此可知，耶和华指着亚哈家所说的话一句没有落空，因为耶和华借他仆人以利亚所说的话都成就了。」
10.en: Know now that nothing will fall to the earth of the LORD’s word, which the LORD spoke concerning Ahab’s house. For the LORD has done that which he spoke by his servant Elijah.”

10.zh: 凡亚哈家在耶斯列所剩下的人和他的大臣、密友、祭司，耶户尽都杀了，没有留下一个。
10.en: So Jehu struck all that remained of Ahab’s house in Jezreel, with all his great men, his familiar friends, and his priests, until he left him no one remaining.

10.zh: 耶户起身往撒马利亚去。在路上、牧人剪羊毛之处，
10.en: He arose and departed, and went to Samaria. As he was at the shearing house of the shepherds on the way,

10.zh: 遇见犹大王亚哈谢的弟兄，问他们说：「你们是谁？」回答说：「我们是亚哈谢的弟兄，现在下去要问王和太后的众子安。」
10.en: Jehu met with the brothers of Ahaziah king of Judah, and said, “Who are you?” They answered, “We are the brothers of Ahaziah. We are going down to greet the children of the king and the children of the queen.”

10.zh: 耶户吩咐说：「活捉他们！」跟从的人就活捉了他们，将他们杀在剪羊毛之处的坑边，共四十二人，没有留下一个。
10.en: He said, “Take them alive!” They took them alive, and killed them at the pit of the shearing house, even forty-two men. He didn’t leave any of them.

10.zh: 耶户从那里前行，恰遇利甲的儿子约拿达来迎接他，耶户问他安，对他说：「你诚心待我像我诚心待你吗？」约拿达回答说：「是。」耶户说：「若是这样，你向我伸手」，他就伸手；耶户拉他上车。
10.en: When he had departed from there, he met Jehonadab the son of Rechab coming to meet him. He greeted him, and said to him, “Is your heart right, as my heart is with your heart?” Jehonadab answered, “It is.” “If it is, give me your hand.” He gave him his hand; and he took him up to him into the chariot.

10.zh: 耶户说：「你和我同去，看我为耶和华怎样热心」；于是请他坐在车上，
10.en: He said, “Come with me, and see my zeal for the LORD.” So they made him ride in his chariot.

10.zh: 到了撒马利亚，就把撒马利亚的亚哈家剩下的人都杀了，直到灭尽，正如耶和华对以利亚所说的。
10.en: When he came to Samaria, he struck all who remained to Ahab in Samaria, until he had destroyed them, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke to Elijah.

10.zh: 耶户招聚众民，对他们说：「亚哈事奉巴力还冷淡，耶户却更热心。
10.en: Jehu gathered all the people together, and said to them, “Ahab served Baal a little, but Jehu will serve him much.

10.zh: 现在我要给巴力献大祭。应当叫巴力的众先知和一切拜巴力的人，并巴力的众祭司，都到我这里来，不可缺少一个；凡不来的必不得活。」耶户这样行，是用诡计要杀尽拜巴力的人。
10.en: Now therefore call to me all the prophets of Baal, all of his worshipers, and all of his priests. Let no one be absent, for I have a great sacrifice to Baal. Whoever is absent, he shall not live.” But Jehu did deceptively, intending to destroy the worshipers of Baal.

10.zh: 耶户说：「要为巴力宣告严肃会！」于是宣告了。
10.en: Jehu said, “Sanctify a solemn assembly for Baal!” So they proclaimed it.

10.zh: 耶户差人走遍以色列地；凡拜巴力的人都来齐了，没有一个不来的。他们进了巴力庙，巴力庙中从前边直到后边都满了人。
10.en: Jehu sent through all Israel; and all the worshipers of Baal came, so that there was not a man left that didn’t come. They came into the house of Baal; and the house of Baal was filled from one end to another.

10.zh: 耶户吩咐掌管礼服的人说：「拿出礼服来，给一切拜巴力的人穿。」他就拿出礼服来给了他们。
10.en: He said to him who kept the wardrobe, “Bring out robes for all the worshipers of Baal!” So he brought robes out to them.

10.zh: 耶户和利甲的儿子约拿达进了巴力庙，对拜巴力的人说：「你们察看察看，在你们这里不可有耶和华的仆人，只可容留拜巴力的人。」
10.en: Jehu went with Jehonadab the son of Rechab into the house of Baal. Then he said to the worshipers of Baal, “Search, and see that none of the servants of the LORD are here with you, but only the worshipers of Baal.”

10.zh: 耶户和约拿达进去，献[平安]祭和燔祭。 耶户先安派八十人在庙外，吩咐说：「我将这些人交在你们手中，若有一人脱逃，[谁放的]必叫他偿命！」
10.en: So they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had appointed for himself eighty men outside, and said, “If any of the men whom I bring into your hands escape, he who lets him go, his life shall be for the life of him.”

10.zh: 耶户献完了燔祭，就[出来]吩咐护卫兵和众军长说：「你们进去杀他们，不容一人出来！」护卫兵和军长就用刀杀他们，将尸首抛出去，便到巴力庙的城去了，
10.en: As soon as he had finished offering the burnt offering, Jehu said to the guard and to the captains, “Go in and kill them! Let no one escape.” So they struck them with the edge of the sword. The guard and the captains threw the bodies out, and went to the inner shrine of the house of Baal.

10.zh: 将巴力庙中的柱像都拿出来烧了；
10.en: They brought out the pillars that were in the house of Baal and burned them.

10.zh: 毁坏了巴力柱像，拆毁了巴力庙作为厕所，直到今日。
10.en: They broke down the pillar of Baal, and broke down the house of Baal, and made it a latrine, to this day.

10.zh: 这样，耶户在以色列中灭了巴力。
10.en: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.

10.zh: 只是耶户不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，就是拜伯特利和但的金牛犊。
10.en: However, Jehu didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin—the golden calves that were in Bethel and that were in Dan.

10.zh: 耶和华对耶户说：「因你办好我眼中看为正的事，照我的心意待亚哈家，你的子孙必接续你坐以色列的国位，直到四代。」
10.en: The LORD said to Jehu, “Because you have done well in executing that which is right in my eyes, and have done to Ahab’s house according to all that was in my heart, your descendants shall sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation.”

10.zh: 只是耶户不尽心遵守耶和华—以色列　神的律法，不离开耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。
10.en: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD, the God of Israel, with all his heart. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam, with which he made Israel to sin.

10.zh: 在那些日子，耶和华才割裂以色列国，使哈薛攻击以色列的境界，
10.en: In those days the LORD began to cut away parts of Israel; and Hazael struck them in all the borders of Israel

10.zh: 乃是约旦河东、基列全地，从靠近亚嫩谷边的亚罗珥起，就是基列和巴珊的迦得人、吕便人、玛拿西人之地。
10.en: from the Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.

10.zh: 耶户其余的事，凡他所行的和他的勇力都写在以色列诸王记上。
10.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehu, and all that he did, and all his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

10.zh: 耶户与他列祖同睡，葬在撒马利亚；他儿子约哈斯接续他作王。
10.en: Jehu slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria. Jehoahaz his son reigned in his place.

10.zh: 耶户在撒马利亚作以色列王二十八年。
10.en: The time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.

11.zh: 亚哈谢的母亲亚她利雅见她儿子死了，就起来剿灭王室。
11.en: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal offspring.

11.zh: 但约兰王的女儿，亚哈谢的妹子约示巴，将亚哈谢的儿子约阿施从那被杀的王子中偷出来，把他和他的乳母都[藏]在卧房里，躲避亚她利雅，免得被杀。
11.en: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Joram, sister of Ahaziah, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king’s sons who were slain, even him and his nurse, and put them in the bedroom; and they hid him from Athaliah, so that he was not slain.

11.zh: 约阿施和他的乳母藏在耶和华的殿里六年；亚她利雅篡了国位。
11.en: He was with her hidden in the LORD’s house six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.

11.zh: 第七年，耶何耶大打发人叫迦利人和护卫兵的众百夫长来，领他们进了耶和华的殿，与他们立约，使他们在耶和华殿里起誓，又将王的儿子指给他们看，
11.en: In the seventh year Jehoiada sent and fetched the captains over hundreds of the Carites and of the guard, and brought them to him into the LORD’s house; and he made a covenant with them, and made a covenant with them in the LORD’s house, and showed them the king’s son.

11.zh: 吩咐他们说：「你们当这样行：凡安息日进班的三分之一要看守王宫，
11.en: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you must do: a third of you, who come in on the Sabbath, shall be keepers of the watch of the king’s house;

11.zh: 三分之一要在苏珥门，三分之一要在护卫兵院的后门。这样把守王宫，拦阻闲人。
11.en: a third of you shall be at the gate Sur; and a third of you at the gate behind the guard. So you shall keep the watch of the house, and be a barrier.

11.zh: 你们安息日所有出班的三分之二要在耶和华的殿里护卫王；
11.en: The two companies of you, even all who go out on the Sabbath, shall keep the watch of the LORD’s house around the king.

11.zh: 各人手拿兵器，四围护卫王。凡擅入你们班次的必当治死，王出入的时候，你们当跟随他。」
11.en: You shall surround the king, every man with his weapons in his hand; and he who comes within the ranks, let him be slain. Be with the king when he goes out, and when he comes in.”

11.zh: 众百夫长就照着祭司耶何耶大一切所吩咐的去行，各带所管安息日进班出班的人来见祭司耶何耶大。
11.en: The captains over hundreds did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded; and they each took his men, those who were to come in on the Sabbath with those who were to go out on the Sabbath, and came to Jehoiada the priest.

11.zh: 祭司便将耶和华殿里所藏大卫王的枪和盾牌交给百夫长。
11.en: The priest delivered to the captains over hundreds the spears and shields that had been King David’s, which were in the LORD’s house.

11.zh: 护卫兵手中各拿兵器，在坛和殿那里，从殿右直到殿左，站在王子的四围。
11.en: The guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, along by the altar and the house, around the king.

11.zh: 祭司领王子出来，给他戴上冠冕，将律法[书交给他]，膏他作王；众人就拍掌说：「愿王万岁！」
11.en: Then he brought out the king’s son, and put the crown on him, and gave him the covenant; and they made him king and anointed him; and they clapped their hands, and said, “Long live the king!”

11.zh: 亚她利雅听见护卫兵和民的声音，就到民那里，进耶和华的殿，
11.en: When Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people, she came to the people into the LORD’s house;

11.zh: 看见王照例站在柱旁，百夫长和吹号的人侍立在王左右，国中的众民欢乐吹号；亚她利雅就撕裂衣服，喊叫说：「反了！反了！」
11.en: and she looked, and behold, the king stood by the pillar, as the tradition was, with the captains and the trumpets by the king; and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew trumpets. Then Athaliah tore her clothes and cried, “Treason! Treason!”

11.zh: 祭司耶何耶大吩咐管辖军兵的百夫长说：「将她赶出班外，凡跟随她的必用刀杀死！」因为祭司说「不可在耶和华殿里杀她」，
11.en: Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, “Bring her out between the ranks. Kill anyone who follows her with the sword.” For the priest said, “Don’t let her be slain in the LORD’s house.”

11.zh: 众兵就闪开让她去；她从马路上王宫去，便在那里被杀。
11.en: So they seized her; and she went by the way of the horses’ entry to the king’s house, and she was slain there.

11.zh: 耶何耶大使王和民与耶和华立约，作耶和华的民；又使王与民立约。
11.en: Jehoiada made a covenant between the LORD and the king and the people, that they should be the LORD’s people; also between the king and the people.

11.zh: 于是国民都到巴力庙，拆毁了庙，打碎坛和像，又在坛前将巴力的祭司玛坦杀了。祭司耶何耶大派官看守耶和华的殿，
11.en: All the people of the land went to the house of Baal, and broke it down. They broke his altars and his images in pieces thoroughly, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars. The priest appointed officers over the LORD’s house.

11.zh: 又率领百夫长和迦利人与护卫兵，以及国中的众民，请王从耶和华殿下来，由护卫兵的门进入王宫，他就坐了王位。
11.en: He took the captains over hundreds, and the Carites, and the guard, and all the people of the land; and they brought down the king from the LORD’s house, and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king’s house. He sat on the throne of the kings.

11.zh: 国民都欢乐，合城都安静。众人已将亚她利雅在王宫那里用刀杀了。
11.en: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. They had slain Athaliah with the sword at the king’s house.

11.zh: 约阿施登基的时候年方七岁。
11.en: Jehoash was seven years old when he began to reign.

12.zh: 耶户第七年，约阿施登基，在耶路撒冷作王四十年。他母亲名叫西比亚，是别是巴人。
12.en: Jehoash began to reign in the seventh year of Jehu, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zibiah of Beersheba.

12.zh: 约阿施在祭司耶何耶大教训他的时候，就行耶和华眼中看为正的事；
12.en: Jehoash did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes all his days in which Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

12.zh: 只是邱坛还没有废去，百姓仍在那里献祭烧香。
12.en: However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

12.zh: 约阿施对众祭司说：「凡奉到耶和华殿分别为圣之物所值通用的银子，或各人当纳的身价，或乐意奉到耶和华殿的银子，
12.en: Jehoash said to the priests, “All the money of the holy things that is brought into the LORD’s house, in current money, the money of the people for whom each man is evaluated, and all the money that it comes into any man’s heart to bring into the LORD’s house,

12.zh: 你们当从所认识的人收了来，修理殿的一切破坏之处。」
12.en: let the priests take it to them, each man from his donor; and they shall repair the damage to the house, wherever any damage is found.”

12.zh: 无奈到了约阿施王二十三年，祭司仍未修理殿的破坏之处。
12.en: But it was so, that in the twenty-third year of King Jehoash the priests had not repaired the damage to the house.

12.zh: 所以约阿施王召了大祭司耶何耶大和众祭司来，对他们说：「你们怎么不修理殿的破坏之处呢？从今以后，你们不要从所认识的人再收银子，要将所收的交出来，修理殿的破坏之处。」
12.en: Then King Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest, and for the other priests, and said to them, “Why aren’t you repairing the damage to the house? Now therefore take no more money from your treasurers, but deliver it for repair of the damage to the house.”

12.zh: 众祭司答应不再收百姓的银子，也不修理殿的破坏之处。
12.en: The priests consented that they should take no more money from the people, and not repair the damage to the house.

12.zh: 祭司耶何耶大取了一个柜子，在柜盖上钻了一个窟窿，放于坛旁，在进耶和华殿的右边；守门的祭司将奉到耶和华殿的一切银子投在柜里。
12.en: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one comes into the LORD’s house; and the priests who kept the threshold put all the money that was brought into the LORD’s house into it.

12.zh: 他们见柜里的银子多了，便叫王的书记和大祭司上来，将耶和华殿里的银子数算包起来。
12.en: When they saw that there was much money in the chest, the king’s scribe and the high priest came up, and they put it in bags and counted the money that was found in the LORD’s house.

12.zh: 把所平的银子交给督工的，就是耶和华殿里办事的人；他们把银子转交修理耶和华殿的木匠和工人，
12.en: They gave the money that was weighed out into the hands of those who did the work, who had the oversight of the LORD’s house; and they paid it out to the carpenters and the builders who worked on the LORD’s house,

12.zh: 并瓦匠、石匠，又买木料和凿成的石头，修理耶和华殿的破坏之处，以及修理殿的各样使用。
12.en: and to the masons and the stone cutters, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the damage to the LORD’s house, and for all that was laid out for the house to repair it.

12.zh: 但那奉到耶和华殿的银子，没有用以做耶和华殿里的银杯、蜡剪、碗、号，和别样的金银器皿，
12.en: But there were not made for the LORD’s house cups of silver, snuffers, basins, trumpets, any vessels of gold or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into the LORD’s house;

12.zh: 乃将那银子交给督工的人修理耶和华的殿；
12.en: for they gave that to those who did the work, and repaired the LORD’s house with it.

12.zh: 且将银子交给办事的人转交做工的人，不与他们算账，因为他们办事诚实。
12.en: Moreover they didn’t demand an accounting from the men into whose hand they delivered the money to give to those who did the work; for they dealt faithfully.

12.zh: 惟有赎愆祭、赎罪祭的银子没有奉到耶和华的殿，都归祭司。
12.en: The money for the trespass offerings and the money for the sin offerings was not brought into the LORD’s house. It was the priests’.

12.zh: 那时，亚兰王哈薛上来攻打迦 特，攻取了，就定意上来攻打耶路撒冷。
12.en: Then Hazael king of Syria went up and fought against Gath, and took it; and Hazael set his face to go up to Jerusalem.

12.zh: 犹大王约阿施将他列祖犹大王约沙法、约兰、亚哈谢所分别为圣的物和自己所分别为圣的物，并耶和华殿与王宫府库里所有的金子都送给亚兰王哈薛；哈薛就不上耶路撒冷来了。
12.en: Jehoash king of Judah took all the holy things that Jehoshaphat and Jehoram and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own holy things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the LORD’s house, and of the king’s house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria; and he went away from Jerusalem.

12.zh: 约阿施其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。
12.en: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

12.zh: 约阿施的臣仆起来背叛，在下悉拉的米罗宫那里将他杀了。
12.en: His servants arose and made a conspiracy, and struck Joash at the house of Millo, on the way that goes down to Silla.

12.zh: 杀他的那臣仆就是示米押的儿子约撒甲和朔默的儿子约萨拔。众人将他葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子亚玛谢接续他作王。
12.en: For Jozacar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city; and Amaziah his son reigned in his place.

13.zh: 犹大王亚哈谢的儿子约阿施二十三年，耶户的儿子约哈斯在撒马利亚登基作以色列王十七年。
13.en: In the twenty-third year of Joash the son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria for seventeen years.

13.zh: 约哈斯行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，总不离开。
13.en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin. He didn’t depart from it.

13.zh: 于是，耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，将他们屡次交在亚兰王哈薛和他儿子便哈达的手里。
13.en: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hand of Hazael king of Syria, and into the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael, continually.

13.zh: 约哈斯恳求耶和华，耶和华就应允他，因为见以色列人所受亚兰王的欺压。
13.en: Jehoahaz begged the LORD, and the LORD listened to him; for he saw the oppression of Israel, how the king of Syria oppressed them.

13.zh: 耶和华赐给以色列人一位拯救者，使他们脱离亚兰人的手；于是以色列人仍旧安居在家里。
13.en: (The LORD gave Israel a savior, so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians; and the children of Israel lived in their tents as before.

13.zh: 然而，他们不离开耶罗波安家使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪，仍然去行，并且在撒马利亚留下亚舍拉。
13.en: Nevertheless they didn’t depart from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, with which he made Israel to sin, but walked in them; and the Asherah also remained in Samaria.)

13.zh: 亚兰王灭绝约哈斯的民，践踏他们如禾场上的尘沙，只给约哈斯留下五十马兵，十辆战车，一万步兵。
13.en: For he didn’t leave to Jehoahaz of the people any more than fifty horsemen, and ten chariots, and ten thousand footmen; for the king of Syria destroyed them and made them like the dust in threshing.

13.zh: 约哈斯其余的事，凡他所行的和他的勇力都写在以色列诸王记上。
13.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz, and all that he did, and his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

13.zh: 约哈斯与他列祖同睡，葬在撒马利亚。他儿子约阿施接续他作王。
13.en: Jehoahaz slept with his fathers; and they buried him in Samaria; and Joash his son reigned in his place.

13.zh: 犹大王约阿施三十七年，约哈斯的儿子约阿施在撒马利亚登基作以色列王十六年。
13.en: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz began to reign over Israel in Samaria for sixteen years.

13.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的一切罪，仍然去行。
13.en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin; but he walked in them.

13.zh: 约阿施其余的事，凡他所行的和他与犹大王亚玛谢争战的勇力，都写在以色列诸王记上。
13.en: Now the rest of the acts of Joash, and all that he did, and his might with which he fought against Amaziah king of Judah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

13.zh: 约阿施与他列祖同睡，耶罗波安坐了他的位。约阿施与以色列诸王一同葬在撒马利亚。
13.en: Joash slept with his fathers; and Jeroboam sat on his throne. Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

13.zh: 以利沙得了必死的病，以色列王约阿施下来看他，伏在他脸上哭泣，说：「我父啊！我父啊！以色列的战车马兵啊！」
13.en: Now Elisha became sick with the illness of which he died; and Joash the king of Israel came down to him, and wept over him, and said, “My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and its horsemen!”

13.zh: 以利沙对他说：「你取弓箭来。」王就取了弓箭来；
13.en: Elisha said to him, “Take bow and arrows;” and he took bow and arrows for himself.

13.zh: 又对以色列王说：「你用手拿弓。」王就用手拿[弓]。以利沙按手在王的手上，
13.en: He said to the king of Israel, “Put your hand on the bow;” and he put his hand on it. Elisha laid his hands on the king’s hands.

13.zh: 说：「你开朝东的窗户。」他就开了。以利沙说：「射箭吧！」他就射箭。以利沙说：「这是耶和华的得胜箭，就是战胜亚兰人的箭；因为你必在亚弗攻打亚兰人，直到灭尽他们。」
13.en: He said, “Open the window eastward;” and he opened it. Then Elisha said, “Shoot!” and he shot. He said, “The LORD’s arrow of victory, even the arrow of victory over Syria; for you will strike the Syrians in Aphek until you have consumed them.”

13.zh: 以利沙又说：「取几枝箭来。」他就取了来。以利沙说：「打地吧！」他打了三次，便止住了。
13.en: He said, “Take the arrows;” and he took them. He said to the king of Israel, “Strike the ground;” and he struck three times, and stopped.

13.zh: 神人向他发怒，说：「应当击打五六次，就能攻打亚兰人直到灭尽；现在只能打败亚兰人三次。」
13.en: The man of God was angry with him, and said, “You should have struck five or six times. Then you would have struck Syria until you had consumed it, but now you will strike Syria just three times.”

13.zh: 以利沙死了，人将他葬埋。到了新年，有一群摩押人犯境，
13.en: Elisha died, and they buried him. Now the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.

13.zh: 有人正葬死人，忽然看见一群人，就把死人抛在以利沙的坟墓里，一碰着以利沙的骸骨，死人就复活，站起来了。
13.en: As they were burying a man, behold, they saw a band of raiders; and they threw the man into Elisha’s tomb. As soon as the man touched Elisha’s bones, he revived, and stood up on his feet.

13.zh: 约哈斯年间，亚兰王哈薛屡次欺压以色列人。
13.en: Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz.

13.zh: 耶和华却因与亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各所立的约，仍施恩给以色列人，怜恤他们，眷顾他们，不肯灭尽他们，尚未赶逐他们离开自己面前。
13.en: But the LORD was gracious to them, and had compassion on them, and favored them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and would not destroy them and he didn’t cast them from his presence as yet.

13.zh: 亚兰王哈薛死了，他儿子便·哈达接续他作王。
13.en: Hazael king of Syria died; and Benhadad his son reigned in his place.

13.zh: 从前哈薛和约阿施的父亲约哈斯争战，攻取了些城邑，现在约哈斯的儿子约阿施三次打败哈薛的儿子便哈达，就收回了以色列的城邑。
13.en: Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz took again out of the hand of Benhadad the son of Hazael the cities which he had taken out of the hand of Jehoahaz his father by war. Joash struck him three times, and recovered the cities of Israel.

14.zh: 以色列王约哈斯的儿子约阿施第二年，犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢登基。
14.en: In the second year of Joash, son of Joahaz, king of Israel, Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah began to reign.

14.zh: 他登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他母亲名叫约耶但，是耶路撒冷人。
14.en: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jehoaddin of Jerusalem.

14.zh: 亚玛谢行耶和华眼中看为正的事，但不如他祖大卫，乃效法他父约阿施一切所行的；
14.en: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, yet not like David his father. He did according to all that Joash his father had done.

14.zh: 只是邱坛还没有废去，百姓仍在那里献祭烧香。
