14.en: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

14.zh: 国一坚定，就把杀他父王的臣仆杀了，
14.en: As soon as the kingdom was established in his hand, he killed his servants who had slain the king his father,

14.zh: 却没有治死杀王之人的儿子，是照摩西律法书上耶和华所吩咐的说：「不可因子杀父，也不可因父杀子，各人要为本身的罪而死。」
14.en: but the children of the murderers he didn’t put to death, according to that which is written in the book of the law of Moses, as the LORD commanded, saying, “The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, nor the children be put to death for the fathers; but every man shall die for his own sin.”

14.zh: 亚玛谢在盐谷杀了以东人一万，又攻取了西拉，改名叫约帖，直到今日。
14.en: He killed ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt, and took Sela by war, and called its name Joktheel, to this day.

14.zh: 那时，亚玛谢差遣使者去见耶户的孙子约哈斯的儿子以色列王约阿 施，说：「你来，我们二人相见[于战场]。」
14.en: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash, the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu, king of Israel, saying, “Come, let’s look one another in the face.”

14.zh: 以色列王约阿施差遣使者去见犹大王亚玛谢，说：「黎巴嫩的蒺藜差遣使者去见黎巴嫩的香柏树，说：将你的女儿给我儿子为妻。后来黎巴嫩有一只野兽经过，把蒺藜践踏了。
14.en: Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah, saying, “The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, ‘Give your daughter to my son as wife.’ Then a wild animal that was in Lebanon passed by, and trampled down the thistle.

14.zh: 你打败了以东人就心高气傲，你以此为荣耀，在家里安居就罢了，为何要惹祸，使自己和犹大国一同败亡呢？」
14.en: You have indeed struck Edom, and your heart has lifted you up. Enjoy the glory of it, and stay at home; for why should you meddle to your harm, that you fall, even you, and Judah with you?”

14.zh: 亚玛谢却不肯听这话。于是以色列王约阿施上来，在犹大的伯·示麦与犹大王亚玛谢相见[于战场]。
14.en: But Amaziah would not listen. So Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.

14.zh: 犹大人败在以色列人面前，各自逃回家里去了。
14.en: Judah was defeated by Israel; and each man fled to his tent.

14.zh: 以色列王约阿施在伯·示麦擒住亚哈谢的孙子、约阿施的儿子犹大王亚玛谢，就来到耶路撒冷，拆毁耶路撒冷的城墙，从以法莲门直到角门共四百肘，
14.en: Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh and came to Jerusalem, then broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

14.zh: 又将耶和华殿里与王宫府库里所有的金银和器皿都拿了去，并带人去为质，就回撒马利亚去了。
14.en: He took all the gold and silver and all the vessels that were found in the LORD’s house and in the treasures of the king’s house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.

14.zh: 约阿施其余所行的事和他的勇力，并与犹大王亚玛谢争战的事，都写在以色列诸王记上。
14.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did, and his might, and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

14.zh: 约阿施与他列祖同睡，葬在撒马利亚，以色列诸王的坟地里。他儿子耶罗波安接续他作王。
14.en: Jehoash slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his place.

14.zh: 以色列王约哈斯的儿子约阿施死后，犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢又活了十五年。
14.en: Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, fifteen years.

14.zh: 亚玛谢其余的事都写在犹大列王记上。
14.en: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

14.zh: 耶路撒冷有人背叛亚玛谢，他就逃到拉吉；叛党却打发人到拉吉将他杀了。
14.en: They made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish; but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.

14.zh: 人就用马将他的尸首驮到耶路撒冷，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。
14.en: They brought him on horses, and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in David’s city.

14.zh: 犹大众民立亚玛谢的儿子亚撒利雅接续他父作王，那时他年十六岁。
14.en: All the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.

14.zh: 亚玛谢与他列祖同睡之后，亚撒利雅收回以拉他仍归犹大，又重新修理。
14.en: He built Elath and restored it to Judah. After that the king slept with his fathers.

14.zh: 犹大王约阿施的儿子亚玛谢十五年，以色列王约阿施的儿子耶罗波安在撒马利亚登基，作王四十一年。
14.en: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah, Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel began to reign in Samaria for forty-one years.

14.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的一切罪。
14.en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

14.zh: 他收回以色列边界之地，从哈马口直到亚拉巴海，正如耶和华—以色列的　神借他仆人迦特希弗人亚米太的儿子先知约拿所说的。
14.en: He restored the border of Israel from the entrance of Hamath to the sea of the Arabah, according to the LORD, the God of Israel’s word, which he spoke by his servant Jonah the son of Amittai, the prophet, who was from Gath Hepher.

14.zh: 因为耶和华看见以色列人甚是艰苦，无论困住的、自由的都没有了，也无人帮助以色列人。
14.en: For the LORD saw the affliction of Israel, that it was very bitter for all, slave and free; and there was no helper for Israel.

14.zh: 耶和华并没有说要将以色列的名从天下涂抹，乃借约阿施的儿子耶罗波安拯救他们。
14.en: The LORD didn’t say that he would blot out the name of Israel from under the sky; but he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam the son of Joash.

14.zh: 耶罗波安其余的事，凡他所行的和他的勇力，他怎样争战，怎样收回大马士革和[先前属]犹大的哈马归以色列，都写在以色列诸王记上。
14.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all that he did, and his might, how he fought, and how he recovered Damascus, and Hamath, which had belonged to Judah, for Israel, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

14.zh: 耶罗波安与他列祖以色列诸王同睡。他儿子撒迦利雅接续他作王。
14.en: Jeroboam slept with his fathers, even with the kings of Israel; and Zechariah his son reigned in his place.

15.zh: 以色列王耶罗波安二十七年，犹大王亚玛谢的儿子亚撒利雅登基，
15.en: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah began to reign.

15.zh: 他登基的时候年十六岁，在耶路撒冷作王五十二年。他母亲名叫耶可利雅，是耶路撒冷人。
15.en: He was sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.

15.zh: 亚撒利雅行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他父亲亚玛谢一切所行的；
15.en: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.

15.zh: 只是邱坛还没有废去，百姓仍在那里献祭烧香。
15.en: However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

15.zh: 耶和华降灾与王，使他长大麻风，直到死日，他就住在别的宫里。他的儿子约坦管理家事，治理国民。
15.en: The LORD struck the king, so that he was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house. Jotham, the king’s son, was over the household, judging the people of the land.

15.zh: 亚撒利雅其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。
15.en: Now the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

15.zh: 亚撒利雅与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子约坦接续他作王。
15.en: Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city; and Jotham his son reigned in his place.

15.zh: 犹大王亚撒利雅三十八年，耶罗波安的儿子撒迦利雅在撒马利亚作以色列王六个月。
15.en: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah the son of Jeroboam reigned over Israel in Samaria six months.

15.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他列祖所行的，不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。
15.en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as his fathers had done. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

15.zh: 雅比的儿子沙龙背叛他，在百姓面前击杀他，篡了他的位。
15.en: Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and struck him before the people and killed him, and reigned in his place.

15.zh: 撒迦利雅其余的事都写在以色列诸王记上。
15.en: Now the rest of the acts of Zechariah, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

15.zh: 这是从前耶和华应许耶户说：「你的子孙必坐以色列的国位直到四代。」这话果然应验了。
15.en: This was the LORD’s word which he spoke to Jehu, saying, “Your sons to the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.” So it came to pass.

15.zh: 犹大王乌西雅三十九年，雅比的儿子沙龙登基在撒马利亚作王一个月。
15.en: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah, and he reigned for a month in Samaria.

15.zh: 迦底的儿子米拿现从得撒上撒马利亚，杀了雅比的儿子沙龙，篡了他的位。
15.en: Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, came to Samaria, struck Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, killed him, and reigned in his place.

15.zh: 沙龙其余的事和他背叛的情形都写在以色列诸王记上。
15.en: Now the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

15.zh: 那时米拿现从得撒起攻打提斐萨和其四境，击杀城中一切的人，剖开其中所有的孕妇，都因他们没有给他开城。
15.en: Then Menahem attacked Tiphsah and all who were in it and its border areas, from Tirzah. He attacked it because they didn’t open their gates to him, and he ripped up all their women who were with child.

15.zh: 犹大王亚撒利雅三十九年，迦底的儿子米拿现登基，在撒马利亚作以色列王十年。
15.en: In the thirty ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem the son of Gadi began to reign over Israel for ten years in Samaria.

15.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，终身不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。
15.en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

15.zh: 亚述王普勒来攻击以色列国，米拿现给他一千他连得银子，请普勒帮助他坚定国位。
15.en: Pul the king of Assyria came against the land, and Menahem gave Pul one thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.

15.zh: 米拿现向以色列一切大富户索要银子，使他们各出五十舍客勒，就给了亚述王。于是亚述王回去，不在国中停留。
15.en: Menahem exacted the money from Israel, even from all the mighty men of wealth, from each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and didn’t stay there in the land.

15.zh: 米拿现其余的事，凡他所行的都写在以色列诸王记上。
15.en: Now the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

15.zh: 米拿现与他列祖同睡。他儿子比加辖接续他作王。
15.en: Menahem slept with his fathers, and Pekahiah his son reigned in his place.

15.zh: 犹大王亚撒利雅五十年，米拿现的儿子比加辖在撒马利亚登基作以色列王二年。
15.en: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria for two years.

15.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。
15.en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

15.zh: 比加辖的将军、利玛利的儿子比加背叛他，在撒马利亚王宫里的卫所杀了他。亚珥歌伯和亚利耶并基列的五十人帮助比加；比加击杀他，篡了他的位。
15.en: Pekah the son of Remaliah, his captain, conspired against him and attacked him in Samaria, in the fortress of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh; and with him were fifty men of the Gileadites. He killed him, and reigned in his place.

15.zh: 比加辖其余的事，凡他所行的都写在以色列诸王记上。
15.en: Now the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

15.zh: 犹大王亚撒利雅五十二年，利玛利的儿子比加在撒马利亚登基作以色列王二十年。
15.en: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria for twenty years.

15.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，不离开尼八的儿子耶罗波安使以色列人陷在罪里的那罪。
15.en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

15.zh: 以色列王比加年间，亚述王提革拉·毗列色来夺了以云、亚伯·伯·玛迦、亚挪、基低斯、夏琐、基列、加利利，和拿弗他利全地，将这些地方的居民都掳到亚述去了。
15.en: In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali; and he carried them captive to Assyria.

15.zh: 乌西雅的儿子约坦二十年，以拉的儿子何细亚背叛利玛利的儿子比加，击杀他，篡了他的位。
15.en: Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, attacked him, killed him, and reigned in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.

15.zh: 比加其余的事，凡他所行的都写在以色列诸王记上。
15.en: Now the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

15.zh: 以色列王利玛利的儿子比加第二年，犹大王乌西雅的儿子约坦登基。
15.en: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel, Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah began to reign.

15.zh: 他登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王十六年。他母亲名叫耶路沙，是撒督的女儿。
15.en: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerusha the daughter of Zadok.

15.zh: 约坦行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他父亲乌西雅一切所行的；
15.en: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes. He did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.

15.zh: 只是邱坛还没有废去，百姓仍在那里献祭烧香。约坦建立耶和华殿的上门。
15.en: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places. He built the upper gate of the LORD’s house.

15.zh: 约坦其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。
15.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

15.zh: 在那些日子，耶和华才使亚兰王利汛和利玛利的儿子比加去攻击犹大。
15.en: In those days, the LORD began to send Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah against Judah.

15.zh: 约坦与他列祖同睡，葬在他祖大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子亚哈斯接续他作王。
15.en: Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.

16.zh: 利玛利的儿子比加十七年，犹大王约坦的儿子亚哈斯登基。
16.en: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah, Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

16.zh: 他登基的时候年二十岁，在耶路撒冷作王十六年；不像他祖大卫行耶和华—他　神眼中看为正的事，
16.en: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didn’t do that which was right in the LORD his God’s eyes, like David his father.

16.zh: 却效法以色列诸王所行的，又照着耶和华从以色列人面前赶出的外邦人所行可憎的事，使他的儿子经火，
16.en: But he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and even made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel.

16.zh: 并在邱坛上、山冈上、各青翠树下献祭烧香。
16.en: He sacrificed and burned incense in the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.

16.zh: 亚兰王利汛和以色列王利玛利的儿子比加上来攻打耶路撒冷，围困亚哈斯，却不能胜他。
16.en: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to wage war. They besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.

16.zh: 当时亚兰王利汛收回以拉他归与亚兰，将犹大人从以拉他赶出去。亚兰人就来到以拉他，住在那里，直到今日。
16.en: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drove the Jews from Elath; and the Syrians came to Elath, and live there to this day.

16.zh: 亚哈斯差遣使者去见亚述王提革拉·毗列色，说：「我是你的仆人、你的儿子。现在亚兰王和以色列王攻击我，求你来救我脱离他们的手。」
16.en: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, saying, “I am your servant and your son. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria and out of the hand of the king of Israel, who rise up against me.”

16.zh: 亚哈斯将耶和华殿里和王宫府库里所有的金银都送给亚述王为礼物。
16.en: Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the LORD’s house, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.

16.zh: 亚述王应允了他，就上去攻打大马士革，将城攻取，杀了利汛，把[居民]掳到吉珥。
16.en: The king of Assyria listened to him; and the king of Assyria went up against Damascus and took it, and carried its people captive to Kir, and killed Rezin.

16.zh: 亚哈斯王上大马士革去迎接亚述王提革拉·毗列色，在大马士革看见一座坛，就照坛的规模样式作法[画了图样]，送到祭司乌利亚那里。
16.en: King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria, and saw the altar that was at Damascus; and King Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest a drawing of the altar and plans to build it.

16.zh: 祭司乌利亚照着亚哈斯王从大马士革送来的图样，在亚哈斯王没有从大马士革回来之先，建筑一座坛。
16.en: Urijah the priest built an altar. According to all that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus, so Urijah the priest made it for the coming of King Ahaz from Damascus.

16.zh: 王从大马士革回来看见坛，就近前来，在坛上献祭；
16.en: When the king had come from Damascus, the king saw the altar; and the king came near to the altar, and offered on it.

16.zh: 烧燔祭、素祭、浇奠祭，将平安祭牲的血洒在坛上，
16.en: He burned his burnt offering and his meal offering, poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings on the altar.

16.zh: 又将耶和华面前的铜坛从耶和华殿和[新]坛的中间搬到[新]坛的北边。
16.en: The bronze altar, which was before the LORD, he brought from the front of the house, from between his altar and the LORD’s house, and put it on the north side of his altar.

16.zh: 亚哈斯王吩咐祭司乌利亚说：「早晨的燔祭、晚上的素祭，王的燔祭、素祭，国内众民的燔祭、素祭、奠祭都要烧在大坛上。燔祭牲和[平安]祭牲的血也要洒在这坛上，只是铜坛我要用以求问[耶和华]。」
16.en: King Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, “On the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, the evening meal offering, the king’s burnt offering and his meal offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, their meal offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle on it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice; but the bronze altar will be for me to inquire by.”

16.zh: 祭司乌利亚就照着亚哈斯王所吩咐的行了。
16.en: Urijah the priest did so, according to all that King Ahaz commanded.

16.zh: 亚哈斯王打掉盆座[四面镶着]的心子，把盆从座上挪下来，又将铜海从驮海的铜牛上搬下来，放在铺石地；
16.en: King Ahaz cut off the panels of the bases, and removed the basin from off them, and took down the sea from off the bronze oxen that were under it, and put it on a pavement of stone.

16.zh: 又因亚述王的缘故，将耶和华殿为安息日所盖的廊子和王从外入殿的廊子挪移，围绕耶和华的殿。
16.en: He removed the covered way for the Sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s outer entrance to the LORD’s house, because of the king of Assyria.

16.zh: 亚哈斯其余所行的事都写在犹大列王记上。
16.en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

16.zh: 亚哈斯与他列祖同睡，葬在大卫城他列祖的坟地里。他儿子希西家接续他作王。
16.en: Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Hezekiah his son reigned in his place.

17.zh: 犹大王亚哈斯十二年，以拉的儿子何细亚在撒马利亚登基作以色列王九年。
17.en: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea the son of Elah began to reign in Samaria over Israel for nine years.

17.zh: 他行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，只是不像在他以前的以色列诸王。
17.en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, yet not as the kings of Israel who were before him.

17.zh: 亚述王撒缦以色上来攻击何细亚，何细亚就服事他，给他进贡。
17.en: Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against him; and Hoshea became his servant, and brought him tribute.

17.zh: 何细亚背叛，差人去见埃及王梭，不照往年所行的与亚述王进贡。亚述王知道了，就把他锁禁，囚在监里。
17.en: The king of Assyria discovered a conspiracy in Hoshea; for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and offered no tribute to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year. Therefore the king of Assyria seized him, and bound him in prison.

17.zh: 亚述王上来攻击以色列遍地，上到撒马利亚，围困三年。
17.en: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.

17.zh: 何细亚第九年亚述王攻取了撒马利亚，将以色列人掳到亚述，把他们安置在哈腊与歌散的哈博河边，并米底亚人的城邑。
17.en: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria and carried Israel away to Assyria, and placed them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

17.zh: 这是因以色列人得罪那领他们出埃及地、脱离埃及王法老手的耶和华—他们的　神，去敬畏别神，
17.en: It was so because the children of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God, who brought them up out of the land of Egypt from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,

17.zh: 随从耶和华在他们面前所赶出外邦人的风俗和以色列诸王所立的条规。
17.en: and walked in the statutes of the nations whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they made.

17.zh: 以色列人暗中行不正的事，违背耶和华—他们的　神，在他们所有的城邑，从了望楼直到坚固城，建筑邱坛；
17.en: The children of Israel secretly did things that were not right against the LORD their God; and they built high places for themselves in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city;

17.zh: 在各高冈上、各青翠树下立柱像和木偶；
17.en: and they set up for themselves pillars and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree;

17.zh: 在邱坛上烧香，效法耶和华在他们面前赶出的外邦人所行的，又行恶事惹动耶和华的怒气；
17.en: and there they burned incense in all the high places, as the nations whom the LORD carried away before them did; and they did wicked things to provoke the LORD to anger;

17.zh: 且事奉偶像，就是耶和华警戒他们不可行的。
17.en: and they served idols, of which the LORD had said to them, “You shall not do this thing.”

17.zh: 但耶和华借众先知、先见劝戒以色列人和犹大人说：「当离开你们的恶行，谨守我的诫命律例，遵行我吩咐你们列祖，并借我仆人众先知所传给你们的律法。」
17.en: Yet the LORD testified to Israel and to Judah, by every prophet and every seer, saying, “Turn from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.”

17.zh: 他们却不听从，竟硬着颈项，效法他们列祖，不信服耶和华—他们的　神，
17.en: Notwithstanding, they would not listen, but hardened their neck like the neck of their fathers who didn’t believe in the LORD their God.

17.zh: 厌弃他的律例和他与他们列祖所立的约，并劝戒他们的话，随从虚无[的神]，自己成为虚妄，效法周围的外邦人，就是耶和华嘱咐他们不可效法的；
17.en: They rejected his statutes and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified to them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and followed the nations that were around them, concerning whom the LORD had commanded them that they should not do like them.

17.zh: 离弃耶和华—他们　神的一切诫命，为自己铸了两个牛犊的像，立了亚舍拉，敬拜天上的万象，事奉巴力，
17.en: They abandoned all the commandments of the LORD their God, and made molten images for themselves, even two calves, and made an Asherah, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served Baal.

17.zh: 又使他们的儿女经火，用占卜，行法术卖了自己，行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，惹动他的怒气。
17.en: They caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

17.zh: 所以耶和华向以色列人大大发怒，从自己面前赶出他们，只剩下犹大一个支派。
17.en: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight. There was none left but the tribe of Judah only.

17.zh: 犹大人也不遵守耶和华—他们　神的诫命，随从以色列人所立的条规。
17.en: Also Judah didn’t keep the commandments of the LORD their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.

17.zh: 耶和华就厌弃以色列全族，使他们受苦，把他们交在抢夺他们的人手中，以致赶出他们离开自己面前，
17.en: The LORD rejected all the offspring of Israel, afflicted them, and delivered them into the hands of raiders, until he had cast them out of his sight.

17.zh: 将以色列国从大卫家夺回；他们就立尼八的儿子耶罗波安作王。耶罗波安引诱以色列人不随从耶和华，陷在大罪里。
17.en: For he tore Israel from David’s house; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king; and Jeroboam drove Israel from following the LORD, and made them sin a great sin.

17.zh: 以色列人犯耶罗波安所犯的一切罪，总不离开，
17.en: The children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they didn’t depart from them

17.zh: 以致耶和华从自己面前赶出他们，正如借他仆人众先知所说的。这样，以色列人从本地被掳到亚述，直到今日。
17.en: until the LORD removed Israel out of his sight, as he said by all his servants the prophets. So Israel was carried away out of their own land to Assyria to this day.

17.zh: 亚述王从巴比伦、古他、亚瓦、哈马，和西法瓦音迁移人来，安置在撒马利亚的城邑，代替以色列人；他们就得了撒马利亚，住在其中。
17.en: The king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, from Cuthah, from Avva, and from Hamath and Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel; and they possessed Samaria and lived in its cities.

17.zh: 他们才住那里的时候，不敬畏耶和华，所以耶和华叫狮子进入他们中间，咬死了些人。
17.en: So it was, at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they didn’t fear the LORD. Therefore the LORD sent lions among them, which killed some of them.

17.zh: 有人告诉亚述王说：「你所迁移安置在撒马利亚各城的那些民，不知道那地之神的规矩，所以那神叫狮子进入他们中间，咬死他们。」
17.en: Therefore they spoke to the king of Assyria, saying, “The nations which you have carried away and placed in the cities of Samaria don’t know the law of the god of the land. Therefore he has sent lions among them; and behold, they kill them, because they don’t know the law of the god of the land.”

17.zh: 亚述王就吩咐说：「叫所掳来的祭司回去一个，使他住在那里，将那地之神的规矩指教那些民。」
17.en: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, “Carry there one of the priests whom you brought from there; and let him go and dwell there, and let him teach them the law of the god of the land.”

17.zh: 于是有一个从撒马利亚掳去的祭司回来，住在伯特利，指教他们怎样敬畏耶和华。
17.en: So one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and lived in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear the LORD.

17.zh: 然而，各族之人在所住的城里各为自己制造神像，安置在撒马利亚人所造有邱坛的殿中。
17.en: However every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities in which they lived.

17.zh: 巴比伦人造疏割·比讷像；古他人造匿甲像；哈马人造亚示玛像；
17.en: The men of Babylon made Succoth Benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,

17.zh: 亚瓦人造匿哈和他珥他像；西法瓦音人用火焚烧儿女，献给西法瓦音的神亚得米勒和亚拿米勒。
17.en: and the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.

17.zh: 他们惧怕耶和华，也从他们中间立邱坛的祭司，为他们在有邱坛的殿中献祭。
17.en: So they feared the LORD, and also made from among themselves priests of the high places for themselves, who sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.

17.zh: 他们又惧怕耶和华，又事奉自己的神，从何邦迁移，就随何邦的风俗。
17.en: They feared the LORD, and also served their own gods, after the ways of the nations from among whom they had been carried away.

17.zh: 他们直到如今仍照先前的风俗去行，不[专心]敬畏耶和华，不[全]守自己的规矩、典章，也不遵守耶和华吩咐雅各后裔的律法、诫命。（雅各，就是从前耶和华起名叫以色列的。）
17.en: To this day they do what they did before. They don’t fear the LORD, and they do not follow the statutes, or the ordinances, or the law, or the commandment which the LORD commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;

17.zh: 耶和华曾与他们立约，嘱咐他们说：「不可敬畏别神，不可跪拜事奉他，也不可向他献祭。
17.en: with whom the LORD had made a covenant and commanded them, saying, “You shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them;

17.zh: 但那用大能和伸出来的膀臂领你们出埃及地的耶和华，你们当敬畏，跪拜，向他献祭。
17.en: but you shall fear the LORD, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and with an outstretched arm, and you shall bow yourselves to him, and you shall sacrifice to him.

17.zh: 他给你们写的律例、典章、律法、诫命，你们应当永远谨守遵行，不可敬畏别神。
17.en: The statutes and the ordinances, and the law and the commandment which he wrote for you, you shall observe to do forever more. You shall not fear other gods.

17.zh: 我—[耶和华]与你们所立的约你们不可忘记，也不可敬畏别神。
17.en: You shall not forget the covenant that I have made with you. You shall not fear other gods.

17.zh: 但要敬畏耶和华—你们的　神，他必救你们脱离一切仇敌的手。」
17.en: But you shall fear the LORD your God, and he will deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.”

17.zh: 他们却不听从，仍照先前的风俗去行。
17.en: However they didn’t listen, but they did what they did before.

17.zh: 如此这些民又惧怕耶和华，又事奉他们的偶像。他们子子孙孙也都照样行，效法他们的祖宗，直到今日。
17.en: So these nations feared the LORD, and also served their engraved images. Their children did likewise, and so did their children’s children. They do as their fathers did to this day.

18.zh: 以色列王以拉的儿子何细亚第三年，犹大王亚哈斯的儿子希西家登基。
18.en: Now in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.

18.zh: 他登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王二十九年。他母亲名叫亚比，是撒迦利雅的女儿。
18.en: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Abi the daughter of Zechariah.

18.zh: 希西家行耶和华眼中看为正的事，效法他祖大卫一切所行的。
18.en: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, according to all that David his father had done.

18.zh: 他废去邱坛，毁坏柱像，砍下木偶，打碎摩西所造的铜蛇，因为到那时以色列人仍向铜蛇烧香。希西家叫铜蛇为铜块。
18.en: He removed the high places, broke the pillars, and cut down the Asherah. He also broke in pieces the bronze serpent that Moses had made, because in those days the children of Israel burned incense to it; and he called it Nehushtan.

18.zh: 希西家倚靠耶和华—以色列的　神，在他前后的犹大列王中没有一个及他的。
18.en: He trusted in the LORD, the God of Israel, so that after him was no one like him among all the kings of Judah, nor among them that were before him.

18.zh: 因为他专靠耶和华，总不离开，谨守耶和华所吩咐摩西的诫命。
18.en: For he joined with the LORD. He didn’t depart from following him, but kept his commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses.

18.zh: 耶和华与他同在，他无论往何处去尽都亨通。他背叛、不肯事奉亚述王。
18.en: The LORD was with him. Wherever he went, he prospered. He rebelled against the king of Assyria, and didn’t serve him.

18.zh: 希西家攻击非利士人，直到迦萨，并迦萨的四境，从了望楼到坚固城。
18.en: He struck the Philistines to Gaza and its borders, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city.

18.zh: 希西家王第四年，就是以色列王以拉的儿子何细亚第七年，亚述王撒缦以色上来围困撒马利亚；
18.en: In the fourth year of King Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria and besieged it.

18.zh: 过了三年就攻取了城。希西家第六年，以色列王何细亚第九年，撒马利亚被攻取了。
18.en: At the end of three years they took it. In the sixth year of Hezekiah, which was the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.

18.zh: 亚述王将以色列人掳到亚述，把他们安置在哈腊与歌散的哈博河边，并米底亚人的城邑；
18.en: The king of Assyria carried Israel away to Assyria, and put them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes,

18.zh: 都因他们不听从耶和华—他们　神的话，违背他的约，就是耶和华仆人摩西吩咐他们所当守的。
18.en: because they didn’t obey the LORD their God’s voice, but transgressed his covenant, even all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded, and would not hear it or do it.

18.zh: 希西家王十四年，亚述王西拿基立上来攻击犹大的一切坚固城，将城攻取。
18.en: Now in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and took them.

18.zh: 犹大王希西家差人往拉吉去见亚述王，说：「我有罪了，求你离开我；凡你罚我的，我必承当。」于是亚述王罚犹大王希西家银子三百他连得，金子三十他连得。
18.en: Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria at Lachish, saying, “I have offended you. Withdraw from me. That which you put on me, I will bear.” The king of Assyria appointed to Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

18.zh: 希西家就把耶和华殿里和王宫府库里所有的银子都给了[他]。
18.en: Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the LORD’s house and in the treasures of the king’s house.

18.zh: 那时，犹大王希西家将耶和华殿门上的[金子]和他自己包在柱上的[金子]都刮下来，给了亚述王。
18.en: At that time, Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the LORD’s temple, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.

18.zh: 亚述王从拉吉差遣他珥探、拉伯撒利，和拉伯沙基率领大军往耶路撒冷，到希西家王那里去。他们上到耶路撒冷，就站在上池的水沟旁，在漂布地的大路上。
18.en: The king of Assyria sent Tartan, Rabsaris, and Rabshakeh from Lachish to King Hezekiah with a great army to Jerusalem. They went up and came to Jerusalem. When they had come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller’s field.

18.zh: 他们呼叫王的时候，就有希勒家的儿子家宰以利亚敬，并书记舍伯那和亚萨的儿子史官约亚，出来见他们。
18.en: When they had called to the king, Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebnah the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder came out to them.

18.zh: 拉伯沙基说：「你们去告诉希西家说，亚述大王如此说：『你所倚靠的有什么可仗赖的呢？
18.en: Rabshakeh said to them, “Say now to Hezekiah, ‘The great king, the king of Assyria, says, “What confidence is this in which you trust?

18.zh: 你说有打仗的计谋和能力，[我看]不过是虚话。你到底倚靠谁才背叛我呢？
18.en: You say (but they are but vain words), ‘There is counsel and strength for war.’ Now on whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me?

18.zh: 看哪，你所倚靠的埃及是那压伤的苇杖；人若靠这杖，就必刺透他的手。埃及王法老向一切倚靠他的人也是这样。
18.en: Now, behold, you trust in the staff of this bruised reed, even in Egypt. If a man leans on it, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust on him.

18.zh: 你们若对我说：我们倚靠耶和华—我们的　神，希西家岂不是将　神的邱坛和祭坛废去，且对犹大和耶路撒冷的人说：你们当在耶路撒冷这坛前敬拜吗？
18.en: But if you tell me, ‘We trust in the LORD our God,’ isn’t that he whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem’?

18.zh: 现在你把当头给我主亚述王，我给你二千匹马，看你这一面骑马的人够不够。
18.en: Now therefore, please give pledges to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses if you are able on your part to set riders on them.

18.zh: 若不然，怎能打败我主臣仆中最小的军长呢？你竟倚靠埃及的战车马兵吗？
18.en: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

18.zh: 现在我上来攻击毁灭这地，岂没有耶和华的意思吗？耶和华吩咐我说：你上去攻击毁灭这地吧！』」
18.en: Have I now come up without the LORD against this place to destroy it? The LORD said to me, ‘Go up against this land, and destroy it.’”’”

18.zh: 希勒家的儿子以利亚敬和舍伯那，并约亚，对拉伯沙基说：「求你用亚兰言语和仆人说话，因为我们懂得；不要用犹大言语和我们说话，达到城上百姓的耳中。」
18.en: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, Shebnah, and Joah, said to Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in the Syrian language, for we understand it. Don’t speak with us in the Jews’ language, in the hearing of the people who are on the wall.”

18.zh: 拉伯沙基说：「我主差遣我来，岂是单对你和你的主说这些话吗？不也是对这些坐在城上、要与你们一同吃自己粪、喝自己尿的人说吗？」
18.en: But Rabshakeh said to them, “Has my master sent me to your master and to you, to speak these words? Hasn’t he sent me to the men who sit on the wall, to eat their own dung, and to drink their own urine with you?”

18.zh: 于是拉伯沙基站着，用犹大言语大声喊着说：「你们当听亚述大王的话！
18.en: Then Rabshakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and spoke, saying, “Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria.

18.zh: 王如此说：『你们不要被希西家欺哄了；因他不能救你们脱离我的手。
18.en: The king says, ‘Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will not be able to deliver you out of his hand.

18.zh: 也不要听希西家使你们倚靠耶和华，说耶和华必要拯救我们，这城必不交在亚述王的手中。』
18.en: Don’t let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD, saying, “The LORD will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”

18.zh: 不要听希西家的话！因亚述王如此说：『你们要与我和好，出来投降我，各人就可以吃自己葡萄树和无花果树的果子，喝自己井里的水。
18.en: Don’t listen to Hezekiah.’ For the king of Assyria says, ‘Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and everyone of you eat from his own vine, and everyone from his own fig tree, and everyone drink water from his own cistern;

18.zh: 等我来领你们到一个地方与你们本地一样，就是有五谷和新酒之地，有粮食和葡萄园之地，有橄榄树和蜂蜜之地，好使你们存活，不至于死。希西家劝导你们，说耶和华必拯救我们；你们不要听他的话。
18.en: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive trees and of honey, that you may live and not die. Don’t listen to Hezekiah when he persuades you, saying, “The LORD will deliver us.”

18.zh: 列国的神有哪一个救他本国脱离亚述王的手呢？
18.en: Has any of the gods of the nations ever delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

18.zh: 哈马、亚珥拔的神在哪里呢？西法瓦音、希拿、以瓦的神在哪里呢？他们曾救撒马利亚脱离我的手吗？
18.en: Where are the gods of Hamath and of Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah? Have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?

18.zh: 这些国的神有谁曾救自己的国脱离我的手呢？难道耶和华能救耶路撒冷脱离我的手吗？』」
18.en: Who are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?’”

18.zh: 百姓静默不言，并不回答一句，因为王曾吩咐说：「不要回答他。」
18.en: But the people stayed quiet, and answered him not a word; for the king’s commandment was, “Don’t answer him.”

18.zh: 当下，希勒家的儿子家宰以利亚敬和书记舍伯那，并亚萨的儿子史官约亚，都撕裂衣服，来到希西家那里，将拉伯沙基的话告诉了他。
18.en: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, came with Shebna the scribe and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him Rabshakeh’s words.

19.zh: 希西家王听见，就撕裂衣服，披上麻布，进了耶和华的殿；
19.en: When King Hezekiah heard it, he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the LORD’s house.

19.zh: 使家宰以利亚敬和书记舍伯那，并祭司中的长老，都披上麻布，去见亚摩斯的儿子先知以赛亚，
19.en: He sent Eliakim, who was over the household, Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

19.zh: 对他说：「希西家如此说：『今日是急难、责罚、凌辱的日子，就如妇人将要生产婴孩，却没有力量生产。
19.en: They said to him, “Hezekiah says, ‘Today is a day of trouble, of rebuke, and of rejection; for the children have come to the point of birth, and there is no strength to deliver them.

19.zh: 或者耶和华—你的　神听见拉伯沙基的一切话，就是他主人亚述王打发他来辱骂永生　神的话，耶和华—你的　神听见这话，就发斥责。故此，求你为余剩的民扬声祷告。』」
19.en: It may be the LORD your God will hear all the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to defy the living God, and will rebuke the words which the LORD your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.’”

19.zh: 希西家王的臣仆就去见以赛亚。
19.en: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

19.zh: 以赛亚对他们说：「要这样对你们的主人说，耶和华如此说：『你听见亚述王的仆人亵渎我的话，不要惧怕。
19.en: Isaiah said to them, “Tell your master this: ‘The LORD says, “Don’t be afraid of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

19.zh: 我必惊动他的心，他要听见风声就归回本地。我必使他在那里倒在刀下。』」
19.en: Behold, I will put a spirit in him, and he will hear news, and will return to his own land. I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.”’”

19.zh: 拉伯沙基回去，正遇见亚述王攻打立拿，原来他早听见亚述王拔营离开拉吉。
19.en: So Rabshakeh returned and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah; for he had heard that he had departed from Lachish.

19.zh: 亚述王听见人论古实王特哈加说：「他出来要与你争战。」于是亚述王又打发使者去见希西家，吩咐他们说：
19.en: When he heard it said of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, “Behold, he has come out to fight against you,” he sent messengers again to Hezekiah, saying,

19.zh: 「你们对犹大王希西家如此说：『不要听你所倚靠的　神欺哄你，说耶路撒冷必不交在亚述王的手中。
19.en: “Tell Hezekiah king of Judah this: ‘Don’t let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, Jerusalem will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.

19.zh: 你总听说亚述诸王向列国所行的，乃是尽行灭绝，难道你还能得救吗？
19.en: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly. Will you be delivered?

19.zh: 我列祖所毁灭的，就是歌散、哈兰、利色，和属提·拉撒的伊甸人，这些国的神何曾拯救这些国呢？
19.en: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed—Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the children of Eden who were in Telassar?

19.zh: 哈马的王、亚珥拔的王、西法瓦音城的王、希拿，和以瓦的王都在哪里呢？』」
19.en: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?’”

19.zh: 希西家从使者手里接过书信来，看完了，就上耶和华的殿，将书信在耶和华面前展开。
19.en: Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it. Then Hezekiah went up to the LORD’s house, and spread it before the LORD.

19.zh: 希西家向耶和华祷告说：「坐在二基路伯上耶和华—以色列的　神啊，你是天下万国的　神，你曾创造天地。
19.en: Hezekiah prayed before the LORD, and said, “LORD, the God of Israel, enthroned above the cherubim, you are the God, even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.

19.zh: 耶和华啊，求你侧耳而听！耶和华啊，求你睁眼而看！要听西拿基立打发使者来辱骂永生　神的话。
19.en: Incline your ear, LORD, and hear. Open your eyes, LORD, and see. Hear the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent to defy the living God.

19.zh: 耶和华啊，亚述诸王果然使列国和列国之地变为荒凉，
19.en: Truly, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste the nations and their lands,

19.zh: 将列国的神像都扔在火里；因为它本不是神，乃是人手所造的，是木头石头的，所以灭绝它。
19.en: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone. Therefore they have destroyed them.

19.zh: 耶和华—我们的　神啊，现在求你救我们脱离亚述王的手，使天下万国都知道惟独你—耶和华是　神！」
19.en: Now therefore, LORD our God, save us, I beg you, out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you, LORD, are God alone.”

19.zh: 亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚就打发人去见希西家，说：「耶和华—以色列的　神如此说：『你既然求我攻击亚述王西拿基立，我已听见了。』
19.en: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, “The LORD, the God of Israel, says ‘You have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria, and I have heard you.

19.zh: 耶和华论他这样说： 锡安的处女藐视你，嗤笑你； 耶路撒冷的女子向你摇头。
19.en: This is the word that the LORD has spoken concerning him: ‘The virgin daughter of Zion has despised you and ridiculed you. The daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.

19.zh: 你辱骂谁？亵渎谁？ 扬起声来，高举眼目攻击谁呢？ 乃是攻击以色列的圣者！
19.en: Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel!

19.zh: 你借你的使者辱骂主， 并说：我率领许多战车上山顶， 到黎巴嫩极深之处； 我要砍伐其中高大的香柏树和佳美的松树； 我必上极高之处，进入肥田的树林。
19.en: By your messengers, you have defied the Lord, and have said, “With the multitude of my chariots, I have come up to the height of the mountains, to the innermost parts of Lebanon, and I will cut down its tall cedars and its choice cypress trees; and I will enter into his farthest lodging place, the forest of his fruitful field.

19.zh: 我已经在外邦挖井喝水； 我必用脚掌踏干埃及的一切河。
19.en: I have dug and drunk strange waters, and I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt with the sole of my feet.”

19.zh: [耶和华说]，我早先所做的， 古时所立的，就是现在借你 使坚固城荒废，变为乱堆， 这事你岂没有听见吗？
19.en: Haven’t you heard how I have done it long ago, and formed it of ancient times? Now I have brought it to pass, that it should be yours to lay waste fortified cities into ruinous heaps.

19.zh: 所以其中的居民力量甚小， 惊惶羞愧。 他们像野草，像青菜， 如房顶上的草， 又如未长成而枯干的禾稼。
19.en: Therefore their inhabitants had little power. They were dismayed and confounded. They were like the grass of the field and like the green herb, like the grass on the housetops and like grain blasted before it has grown up.

19.zh: 你坐下，你出去，你进来， 你向我发烈怒，我都知道。
19.en: But I know your sitting down, your going out, your coming in, and your raging against me.

19.zh: 因你向我发烈怒， 又因你狂傲[的话]达到我耳中， 我就要用钩子钩上你的鼻子， 把嚼环放在你口里， 使你从你来的路转回去。
19.en: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance has come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.’

19.zh: 「以色列人哪，我赐你们一个证据：你们今年要吃自生的，明年也要吃自长的；至于后年，你们要耕种收割，栽植葡萄园，吃其中的果子。
19.en: “This will be the sign to you: This year, you will eat that which grows of itself, and in the second year that which springs from that; and in the third year sow and reap, and plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

19.zh: 犹大家所逃脱余剩的，仍要往下扎根，向上结果。
19.en: The remnant that has escaped of the house of Judah will again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

19.zh: 必有余剩的民从耶路撒冷而出；必有逃脱的人从锡安山而来。耶和华的热心必成就这事。
19.en: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and out of Mount Zion those who shall escape. The LORD’s zeal will perform this.

19.zh: 「所以，耶和华论亚述王如此说：『他必不得来到这城，也不在这里射箭，不得拿盾牌到城前，也不筑垒攻城。
19.en: “Therefore the LORD says concerning the king of Assyria, ‘He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there. He will not come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.

19.zh: 他从哪条路来，必从那条路回去，必不得来到这城。这是耶和华说的。
19.en: He will return the same way that he came, and he will not come to this city,’ says the LORD.

19.zh: 因我为自己的缘故，又为我仆人大卫的缘故，必保护拯救这城。』」
19.en: ‘For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake and for my servant David’s sake.’”

19.zh: 当夜，耶和华的使者出去，在亚述营中杀了十八万五千人。清早有人起来，一看，都是死尸了。
19.en: That night, the LORD’s angel went out and struck one hundred eighty-five thousand in the camp of the Assyrians. When men arose early in the morning, behold, these were all dead bodies.

19.zh: 亚述王西拿基立就拔营回去，住在尼尼微。
19.en: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, went home, and lived at Nineveh.

19.zh: 一日在他的神尼斯洛庙里叩拜，[他儿子]亚得米勒和沙利色用刀杀了他，就逃到亚拉腊地。他儿子以撒哈顿接续他作王。
19.en: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.

20.zh: 那时，希西家病得要死。亚摩斯的儿子先知以赛亚去见他，对他说：「耶和华如此说：『你当留遗命与你的家，因为你必死，不能活了。』」
20.en: In those days Hezekiah was sick and dying. Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came to him, and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Set your house in order; for you will die, and not live.’”

20.zh: 希西家就转脸朝墙，祷告耶和华说：
20.en: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed to the LORD, saying,

20.zh: 「耶和华啊，求你记念我在你面前怎样存完全的心，按诚实行事，又做你眼中所看为善的。」希西家就痛哭了。
20.en: “Remember now, LORD, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight.” And Hezekiah wept bitterly.

20.zh: 以赛亚出来，还没有到中院，耶和华的话就临到他，说：
20.en: Before Isaiah had gone out into the middle part of the city, the LORD’s word came to him, saying,

20.zh: 「你回去告诉我民的君希西家说：耶和华—你祖大卫的　神如此说：『我听见了你的祷告，看见了你的眼泪，我必医治你；到第三日，你必上到耶和华的殿。
20.en: “Turn back, and tell Hezekiah the prince of my people, ‘The LORD, the God of David your father, says, “I have heard your prayer. I have seen your tears. Behold, I will heal you. On the third day, you will go up to the LORD’s house.

20.zh: 我必加增你十五年的寿数，并且我要救你和这城脱离亚述王的手。我为自己和我仆人大卫的缘故，必保护这城。』」
20.en: I will add to your days fifteen years. I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.”’”

20.zh: 以赛亚说：「当取一块无花果饼来。」人就取了来，贴在疮上，王便痊愈了。
20.en: Isaiah said, “Take a cake of figs.” They took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.

20.zh: 希西家问以赛亚说：「耶和华必医治我，到第三日，我能上耶和华的殿，有什么兆头呢？」
20.en: Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “What will be the sign that the LORD will heal me, and that I will go up to the LORD’s house the third day?”

20.zh: 以赛亚说：「耶和华必成就他所说的。这是他给你的兆头：你要日影向前进十度呢？是要往后退十度呢？」
20.en: Isaiah said, “This will be the sign to you from the LORD, that the LORD will do the thing that he has spoken: should the shadow go forward ten steps, or go back ten steps?”

20.zh: 希西家回答说：「日影向前进十度容易，我要日影往后退十度。」
20.en: Hezekiah answered, “It is a light thing for the shadow to go forward ten steps. No, but let the shadow return backward ten steps.”

20.zh: 先知以赛亚求告耶和华，耶和华就使亚哈斯的日晷向前进的日影，往后退了十度。
20.en: Isaiah the prophet cried to the LORD; and he brought the shadow ten steps backward, by which it had gone down on the sundial of Ahaz.

20.zh: 那时，巴比伦王巴拉但的儿子米罗达·巴拉但听见希西家病而痊愈，就送书信和礼物给他。
20.en: At that time Berodach Baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah, for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.

20.zh: 希西家听从使者的话，就把他宝库的金子、银子、香料、贵重的膏油，和他武库的一切军器，并他所有的财宝，都给他们看。他家中和他全国之内，希西家没有一样不给他们看的。
20.en: Hezekiah listened to them, and showed them all the storehouse of his precious things—the silver, the gold, the spices, and the precious oil, and the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures. There was nothing in his house, or in all his dominion, that Hezekiah didn’t show them.

20.zh: 于是先知以赛亚来见希西家王，问他说：「这些人说什么？他们从哪里来见你？」希西家说：「他们从远方的巴比伦来。」
20.en: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah, and said to him, “What did these men say? From where did they come to you?” Hezekiah said, “They have come from a far country, even from Babylon.”

20.zh: 以赛亚说：「他们在你家里看见了什么？」希西家说：「凡我家中所有的，他们都看见了；我财宝中没有一样不给他们看的。」
20.en: He said, “What have they seen in your house?” Hezekiah answered, “They have seen all that is in my house. There is nothing among my treasures that I have not shown them.”

20.zh: 以赛亚对希西家说：「你要听耶和华的话，
20.en: Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear the LORD’s word.

20.zh: 日子必到，凡你家里所有的，并你列祖积蓄到如今的，都要被掳到巴比伦去，不留下一样。这是耶和华说的。
20.en: ‘Behold, the days come that all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have laid up in store to this day, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will be left,’ says the LORD.

20.zh: 并且从你本身所生的众子，其中必有被掳去在巴比伦王宫里当太监的。」
20.en: ‘They will take away some of your sons who will issue from you, whom you will father; and they will be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.’”

20.zh: 希西家对以赛亚说：「你所说耶和华的话甚好！若在我的年日中有太平和稳固的景况，岂不是好吗？」
20.en: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “The LORD’s word which you have spoken is good.” He said moreover, “Isn’t it so, if peace and truth will be in my days?”

20.zh: 希西家其余的事和他的勇力，他怎样挖池、挖沟、引水入城，都写在犹大列王记上。
20.en: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made the pool, and the conduit, and brought water into the city, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

20.zh: 希西家与他列祖同睡。他儿子玛拿西接续他作王。
20.en: Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and Manasseh his son reigned in his place.

21.zh: 玛拿西登基的时候年十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王五十五年。他母亲名叫协西巴。
21.en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hephzibah.

21.zh: 玛拿西行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法耶和华在以色列人面前赶出的外邦人所行可憎的事。
21.en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, after the abominations of the nations whom the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.

21.zh: 重新建筑他父希西家所毁坏的邱坛，又为巴力筑坛，做亚舍拉像，效法以色列王亚哈所行的，且敬拜事奉天上的万象；
21.en: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he raised up altars for Baal, and made an Asherah, as Ahab king of Israel did, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served them.

21.zh: 在耶和华殿宇中筑坛。耶和华曾指着这殿说：「我必立我的名在耶路撒冷。」
21.en: He built altars in the LORD’s house, of which the LORD said, “I will put my name in Jerusalem.”

21.zh: 他在耶和华殿的两院中为天上的万象筑坛，
21.en: He built altars for all the army of the sky in the two courts of the LORD’s house.

21.zh: 并使他的儿子经火，又观兆，用法术，立交鬼的和行巫术的，多行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，惹动他的怒气；
21.en: He made his son to pass through the fire, practiced sorcery, used enchantments, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits and with wizards. He did much evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

21.zh: 又在殿内立雕刻的亚舍拉像。耶和华曾对大卫和他儿子所罗门说：「我在以色列众支派中所选择的耶路撒冷和这殿，必立我的名，直到永远。
21.en: He set the engraved image of Asherah that he had made in the house of which the LORD said to David and to Solomon his son, “In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name forever;

21.zh: 以色列人若谨守遵行我一切所吩咐他们的和我仆人摩西所吩咐他们的一切律法，我就不再使他们挪移离开我所赐给他们列祖之地。」
21.en: I will not cause the feet of Israel to wander any more out of the land which I gave their fathers, if only they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.”

21.zh: 他们却不听从。玛拿西引诱他们行恶，比耶和华在以色列人面前所灭的列国更甚。
21.en: But they didn’t listen, and Manasseh seduced them to do that which is evil more than the nations did whom the LORD destroyed before the children of Israel.

21.zh: 耶和华借他仆人众先知说：
21.en: The LORD spoke by his servants the prophets, saying,

21.zh: 「因犹大王玛拿西行这些可憎的恶事比先前亚摩利人所行的更甚，使犹大人拜他的偶像，陷在罪里；
21.en: “Because Manasseh king of Judah has done these abominations, and has done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, who were before him, and has also made Judah to sin with his idols;

21.zh: 所以耶和华—以色列的　神如此说：我必降祸与耶路撒冷和犹大，叫一切听见的人无不耳鸣。
21.en: therefore the LORD the God of Israel says, ‘Behold, I will bring such evil on Jerusalem and Judah that whoever hears of it, both his ears will tingle.

21.zh: 我必用量撒马利亚的准绳和亚哈家的线铊拉在耶路撒冷上，必擦净耶路撒冷，如人擦盘，将盘倒扣。
21.en: I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plumb line of Ahab’s house; and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.

21.zh: 我必弃掉所余剩的子民，把他们交在仇敌手中，使他们成为一切仇敌掳掠之物；
21.en: I will cast off the remnant of my inheritance and deliver them into the hands of their enemies. They will become a prey and a plunder to all their enemies,

21.zh: 是因他们自从列祖出埃及直到如今，常行我眼中看为恶的事，惹动我的怒气。」
21.en: because they have done that which is evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger since the day their fathers came out of Egypt, even to this day.’”

21.zh: 玛拿西行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，使犹大人陷在罪里，又流许多无辜人的血，充满了耶路撒冷，从这边直到那边。
21.en: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, until he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; in addition to his sin with which he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.

21.zh: 玛拿西其余的事，凡他所行的和他所犯的罪都写在犹大列王记上。
21.en: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

21.zh: 玛拿西与他列祖同睡，葬在自己宫院乌撒的园内；他儿子亚们接续他作王。
21.en: Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza; and Amon his son reigned in his place.

21.zh: 亚们登基的时候年二十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王二年。他母亲名叫米舒利密，是约提巴人哈鲁斯的女儿。
21.en: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Meshullemeth the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

21.zh: 亚们行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，与他父亲玛拿西所行的一样；
21.en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as Manasseh his father did.

21.zh: 行他父亲一切所行的，敬奉他父亲所敬奉的偶像，
21.en: He walked in all the ways that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshiped them;

21.zh: 离弃耶和华—他列祖的　神，不遵行耶和华的道。
21.en: and he abandoned the LORD, the God of his fathers, and didn’t walk in the way of the LORD.

21.zh: 亚们王的臣仆背叛他，在宫里杀了他。
21.en: The servants of Amon conspired against him, and put the king to death in his own house.

21.zh: 但国民杀了那些背叛亚们王的人，立他儿子约西亚接续他作王。
21.en: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.

21.zh: 亚们其余所行的事都写在犹大列王记上。
21.en: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

21.zh: 亚们葬在乌撒的园内自己的坟墓里。他儿子约西亚接续他作王。
21.en: He was buried in his tomb in the garden of Uzza, and Josiah his son reigned in his place.

22.zh: 约西亚登基的时候年八岁，在耶路撒冷作王三十一年。他母亲名叫耶底大，是波斯加人亚大雅的女儿。
22.en: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jedidah the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.

22.zh: 约西亚行耶和华眼中看为正的事，行他祖大卫一切所行的，不偏左右。
22.en: He did that which was right in the LORD’s eyes, and walked in all the ways of David his father, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left.

22.zh: 约西亚王十八年，王差遣米书兰的孙子、亚萨利的儿子—书记沙番上耶和华殿去，吩咐他说：
22.en: In the eighteenth year of King Josiah, the king sent Shaphan, the son of Azaliah the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the LORD’s house, saying,

22.zh: 「你去见大祭司希勒家，使他将奉到耶和华殿的银子，就是守门的从民中收聚的银子，数算数算，
22.en: “Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may count the money which is brought into the LORD’s house, which the keepers of the threshold have gathered of the people.

22.zh: 交给耶和华殿里办事的人，使他们转交耶和华殿里做工的人，好修理殿的破坏之处，
22.en: Let them deliver it into the hand of the workers who have the oversight of the LORD’s house; and let them give it to the workers who are in the LORD’s house, to repair the damage to the house,

22.zh: 就是转交木匠和工人，并瓦匠，又买木料和凿成的石头修理殿宇，
22.en: to the carpenters, and to the builders, and to the masons, and for buying timber and cut stone to repair the house.

22.zh: 将银子交在办事的人手里，不与他们算帐，因为他们办事诚实。」
22.en: However, no accounting shall be asked of them for the money delivered into their hand, for they deal faithfully.”

22.zh: 大祭司希勒家对书记沙番说：「我在耶和华殿里得了律法书。」希勒家将书递给沙番，沙番就看了。
22.en: Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, “I have found the book of the law in the LORD’s house.” Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

22.zh: 书记沙番到王那里，回复王说：「你的仆人已将殿里的银子倒出数算，交给耶和华殿里办事的人了。」
22.en: Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, “Your servants have emptied out the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hands of the workmen who have the oversight of the LORD’s house.”

22.zh: 书记沙番又对王说：「祭司希勒家递给我一卷书。」沙番就在王面前读那书。
22.en: Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, “Hilkiah the priest has delivered a book to me.” Then Shaphan read it before the king.

22.zh: 王听见律法书上的话，便撕裂衣服，
22.en: When the king had heard the words of the book of the law, he tore his clothes.

22.zh: 吩咐祭司希勒家与沙番的儿子亚希甘、米该亚的儿子亚革波、书记沙番和王的臣仆亚撒雅，说：
22.en: The king commanded Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Achbor the son of Micaiah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying,

22.zh: 「你们去为我、为民、为犹大众人，以这书上的话求问耶和华；因为我们列祖没有听从这书上的言语，没有遵着书上所吩咐我们的去行，耶和华就向我们大发烈怒。」
22.en: “Go inquire of the LORD for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that is found; for great is the LORD’s wrath that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not listened to the words of this book, to do according to all that which is written concerning us.”

22.zh: 于是，祭司希勒家和亚希甘、亚革波、沙番、亚撒雅都去见女先知户勒大。户勒大是掌管礼服沙龙的妻；沙龙是哈珥哈斯的孙子、特瓦的儿子。户勒大住在耶路撒冷第二区。他们请问于她。
22.en: So Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe (now she lived in Jerusalem in the second quarter); and they talked with her.

22.zh: 她对他们说：「耶和华—以色列的　神如此说：『你们可以回复那差遣你们来见我的人说，
22.en: She said to them, “The LORD the God of Israel says, ‘Tell the man who sent you to me,

22.zh: 耶和华如此说：我必照着犹大王所读那书上的一切话，降祸与这地和其上的居民。
22.en: “The LORD says, ‘Behold, I will bring evil on this place and on its inhabitants, even all the words of the book which the king of Judah has read.

22.zh: 因为他们离弃我，向别神烧香，用他们手所做的惹我发怒，所以我的忿怒必向这地发作，总不止息。』
22.en: Because they have forsaken me and have burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the work of their hands, therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and it will not be quenched.’”

22.zh: 然而，差遣你们来求问耶和华的犹大王，你们要这样回复他说：『耶和华—以色列的　神如此说：至于你所听见的话，
22.en: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, tell him, “The LORD the God of Israel says, ‘Concerning the words which you have heard,

22.zh: 就是听见我指着这地和其上的居民所说、要使这地变为荒场、民受咒诅的话，你便心里敬服，在我面前自卑，撕裂衣服，向我哭泣，因此我应允了你。这是我—耶和华说的。
22.en: because your heart was tender, and you humbled yourself before the LORD when you heard what I spoke against this place and against its inhabitants, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and have torn your clothes and wept before me, I also have heard you,’ says the LORD.

22.zh: 我必使你平平安安地归到坟墓到你列祖那里；我要降与这地的一切灾祸，你也不至亲眼看见。』」他们就回复王去了。
22.en: ‘Therefore behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be gathered to your grave in peace. Your eyes will not see all the evil which I will bring on this place.’”’” So they brought this message back to the king.

23.zh: 王差遣人招聚犹大和耶路撒冷的众长老来。
23.en: The king sent, and they gathered to him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.

23.zh: 王和犹大众人与耶路撒冷的居民，并祭司、先知，和所有的百姓，无论大小，都一同上到耶和华的殿；王就把耶和华殿里所得的约书念给他们听。
23.en: The king went up to the LORD’s house, and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him—with the priests, the prophets, and all the people, both small and great; and he read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the LORD’s house.

23.zh: 王站在柱旁，在耶和华面前立约，要尽心尽性地顺从耶和华，遵守他的诫命、法度、律例，成就这书上所记的约言。众民都服从这约。
23.en: The king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before the LORD to walk after the LORD and to keep his commandments, his testimonies, and his statutes with all his heart and all his soul, to confirm the words of this covenant that were written in this book; and all the people agreed to the covenant.

23.zh: 王吩咐大祭司希勒家和副祭司，并把门的，将那为巴力和亚舍拉，并天上万象所造的器皿，都从耶和华殿里搬出来，在耶路撒冷外汲沦溪旁的田间烧了，把灰拿到伯特利去。
23.en: The king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the threshold, to bring out of the LORD’s temple all the vessels that were made for Baal, for the Asherah, and for all the army of the sky; and he burned them outside of Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron, and carried their ashes to Bethel.

23.zh: 从前犹大列王所立拜偶像的祭司，在犹大城邑的邱坛和耶路撒冷的周围烧香，现在王都废去，又废去向巴力和日、月、行星，并天上万象烧香的人；
23.en: He got rid of the idolatrous priests whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah and in the places around Jerusalem; those also who burned incense to Baal, to the sun, to the moon, to the planets, and to all the army of the sky.

23.zh: 又从耶和华殿里将亚舍拉搬到耶路撒冷外汲沦溪边焚烧，打碎成灰，将灰撒在平民的坟上；
23.en: He brought out the Asherah from the LORD’s house, outside of Jerusalem, to the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and beat it to dust, and cast its dust on the graves of the common people.

23.zh: 又拆毁耶和华殿里娈童的屋子，就是妇女为亚舍拉织帐子的屋子，
23.en: He broke down the houses of the male shrine prostitutes that were in the LORD’s house, where the women wove hangings for the Asherah.

23.zh: 并且从犹大的城邑带众祭司来，污秽祭司烧香的邱坛，从迦巴直到别是巴，又拆毁城门旁的邱坛，这邱坛在邑宰约书亚门前，进城门的左边。
23.en: He brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba; and he broke down the high places of the gates that were at the entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which were on a man’s left hand at the gate of the city.

23.zh: 但是邱坛的祭司不登耶路撒冷耶和华的坛，只在他们弟兄中间吃无酵饼。
23.en: Nevertheless the priests of the high places didn’t come up to the LORD’s altar in Jerusalem, but they ate unleavened bread among their brothers.

23.zh: 又污秽欣嫩子谷的陀斐特，不许人在那里使儿女经火献给摩洛；
23.en: He defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.

23.zh: 又将犹大列王在耶和华殿门旁、太监拿单·米勒靠近游廊的屋子、向日头所献的马废去，且用火焚烧日车。
23.en: He took away the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun, at the entrance of the LORD’s house, by the room of Nathan Melech the officer who was in the court; and he burned the chariots of the sun with fire.

23.zh: 犹大列王在亚哈斯楼顶上所筑的坛和玛拿西在耶和华殿两院中所筑的坛，王都拆毁打碎了，就把灰倒在汲沦溪中。
23.en: The king broke down the altars that were on the roof of the upper room of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the LORD’s house, and beat them down from there, and cast their dust into the brook Kidron.

23.zh: 从前以色列王所罗门在耶路撒冷前、邪僻山右边为西顿人可憎的神亚斯她录、摩押人可憎的神基抹、亚扪人可憎的神米勒公所筑的邱坛，王都污秽了，
23.en: The king defiled the high places that were before Jerusalem, which were on the right hand of the mountain of corruption, which Solomon the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon.

23.zh: 又打碎柱像，砍下木偶，将人的骨头充满了那地方。
23.en: He broke in pieces the pillars, cut down the Asherah poles, and filled their places with men’s bones.

23.zh: 他将伯特利的坛，就是叫以色列人陷在罪里、尼八的儿子耶罗波安所筑的那坛，都拆毁焚烧，打碎成灰，并焚烧了亚舍拉。
23.en: Moreover the altar that was at Bethel and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, even that altar and the high place he broke down; and he burned the high place and beat it to dust, and burned the Asherah.

23.zh: 约西亚回头，看见山上的坟墓，就打发人将坟墓里的骸骨取出来，烧在坛上，污秽了坛，正如从前神人宣传耶和华的话。
23.en: As Josiah turned himself, he spied the tombs that were there in the mountain; and he sent, and took the bones out of the tombs, and burned them on the altar, and defiled it, according to the LORD’s word which the man of God proclaimed, who proclaimed these things.

23.zh: 约西亚问说：「我所看见的是什么碑？」那城里的人回答说：「先前有神人从犹大来，预先说王现在向伯特利坛所行的事，这就是他的墓碑。」
23.en: Then he said, “What monument is that which I see?” The men of the city told him, “It is the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and proclaimed these things that you have done against the altar of Bethel.”

23.zh: 约西亚说：「由他吧！不要挪移他的骸骨。」他们就不动他的骸骨，也不动从撒马利亚来那先知的骸骨。
23.en: He said, “Let him be! Let no one move his bones.” So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet who came out of Samaria.

23.zh: 从前以色列诸王在撒马利亚的城邑建筑邱坛的殿，惹动[耶和华]的怒气，现在约西亚都废去了，就如他在伯特利所行的一般；
23.en: All the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke the LORD to anger, Josiah took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Bethel.

23.zh: 又将邱坛的祭司都杀在坛上，并在坛上烧人的骨头，就回耶路撒冷去了。
23.en: He killed all the priests of the high places that were there, on the altars, and burned men’s bones on them; and he returned to Jerusalem.

23.zh: 王吩咐众民说：「你们当照这约书上所写的，向耶和华—你们的　神守逾越节。」
23.en: The king commanded all the people, saying, “Keep the Passover to the LORD your God, as it is written in this book of the covenant.”

23.zh: 自从士师治理以色列人和以色列王、犹大王的时候，[直到如今]，实在没有守过这样的逾越节；
23.en: Surely there was not kept such a Passover from the days of the judges who judged Israel, nor in all the days of the kings of Israel, nor of the kings of Judah;

23.zh: 只有约西亚王十八年在耶路撒冷向耶和华守这逾越节。
23.en: but in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, this Passover was kept to the LORD in Jerusalem.

23.zh: 凡犹大国和耶路撒冷所有交鬼的、行巫术的，与家中的神像和偶像，并一切可憎之物，约西亚尽都除掉，成就了祭司希勒家在耶和华殿里所得律法书上所写的话。
23.en: Moreover, Josiah removed those who had familiar spirits, the wizards, and the teraphim, and the idols, and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, that he might confirm the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the LORD’s house.

23.zh: 在约西亚以前没有王像他尽心、尽性、尽力地归向耶和华，遵行摩西的一切律法；在他以后也没有兴起一个王像他。
23.en: There was no king like him before him, who turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; and there was none like him who arose after him.

23.zh: 然而，耶和华向犹大所发猛烈的怒气仍不止息，是因玛拿西诸事惹动他。
23.en: Notwithstanding, the LORD didn’t turn from the fierceness of his great wrath, with which his anger burned against Judah, because of all the provocation with which Manasseh had provoked him.

23.zh: 耶和华说：「我必将犹大人从我面前赶出，如同赶出以色列人一般；我必弃掉我从前所选择的这城—耶路撒冷和我所说立我名的殿。」
23.en: The LORD said, “I will also remove Judah out of my sight, as I have removed Israel; and I will cast off this city which I have chosen, even Jerusalem, and the house of which I said, ‘My name shall be there.’”

23.zh: 约西亚其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。
23.en: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

23.zh: 约西亚年间，埃及王法老尼哥上到幼发拉底河攻击亚述王；约西亚王去抵挡他。埃及王遇见约西亚在米吉多，就杀了他。
23.en: In his days Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates; and King Josiah went against him, but Pharaoh Necoh killed him at Megiddo when he saw him.

23.zh: 他的臣仆用车将他的尸首从米吉多送到耶路撒冷，葬在他自己的坟墓里。国民膏约西亚的儿子约哈斯接续他父亲作王。
23.en: His servants carried him dead in a chariot from Megiddo, brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own tomb. The people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s place.

23.zh: 约哈斯登基的时候年二十三岁，在耶路撒冷作王三个月。他母亲名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。
23.en: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

23.zh: 约哈斯行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他列祖一切所行的。
23.en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.

23.zh: 法老尼哥将约哈斯锁禁在哈马地的利比拉，不许他在耶路撒冷作王，又罚[犹大]国银子一百他连得，金子一他连得。
23.en: Pharaoh Necoh put him in bonds at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

23.zh: 法老尼哥立约西亚的儿子以利亚敬接续他父亲约西亚作王，给他改名叫约雅敬，却将约哈斯带到埃及，他就死在那里。
23.en: Pharaoh Necoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the place of Josiah his father, and changed his name to Jehoiakim; but he took Jehoahaz away, and he came to Egypt and died there.

23.zh: 约雅敬将金银给法老，遵着法老的命向国民征取金银，按着各人的力量派定，索要金银，好给法老尼哥。
23.en: Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh. He exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, from everyone according to his assessment, to give it to Pharaoh Necoh.

23.zh: 约雅敬登基的时候年二十五岁，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母亲名叫西布大，是鲁玛人毗大雅的女儿。
23.en: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zebidah the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

23.zh: 约雅敬行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他列祖一切所行的。
23.en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.

24.zh: 约雅敬年间，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒上[到 犹大]；约雅敬服事他三年，然后背叛他。
24.en: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant for three years. Then he turned and rebelled against him.

24.zh: 耶和华使迦勒底军、亚兰军、摩押军，和亚扪人的军来攻击约雅敬，毁灭犹大，正如耶和华借他仆人众先知所说的。
24.en: The LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldeans, bands of the Syrians, bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke by his servants the prophets.

24.zh: 这祸临到犹大人，诚然是耶和华所命的，要将他们从自己面前赶出，是因玛拿西所犯的一切罪；
24.en: Surely at the commandment of the LORD this came on Judah, to remove them out of his sight for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did,

24.zh: 又因他流无辜人的血，充满了耶路撒冷；耶和华决不肯赦免。
24.en: and also for the innocent blood that he shed; for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the LORD would not pardon.

24.zh: 约雅敬其余的事，凡他所行的都写在犹大列王记上。
24.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

24.zh: 约雅敬与他列祖同睡。他儿子约雅斤接续他作王。
24.en: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers, and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.

24.zh: 埃及王不再从他国中出来；因为巴比伦王将埃及王所管之地，从埃及小河直到幼发拉底河都夺去了。
24.en: The king of Egypt didn’t come out of his land any more; for the king of Babylon had taken, from the brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates, all that belonged to the king of Egypt.

24.zh: 约雅斤登基的时候年十八岁，在耶路撒冷作王三个月。他母亲名叫尼护施她，是耶路撒冷人以利拿单的女儿。
24.en: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

24.zh: 约雅斤行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，效法他父亲一切所行的。
24.en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his father had done.

24.zh: 那时，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒的军兵上到耶路撒冷，围困城。
24.en: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up to Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

24.zh: 当他军兵围困城的时候，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒就亲自来了。
24.en: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging it,

24.zh: 犹大王约雅斤和他母亲、臣仆、首领、太监一同出城，投降巴比伦王；巴比伦王便拿住他。那时是巴比伦王第八年。
24.en: and Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon—he, his mother, his servants, his princes, and his officers; and the king of Babylon captured him in the eighth year of his reign.

24.zh: 巴比伦王将耶和华殿和王宫里的宝物都拿去了，将以色列王所罗门所造耶和华殿里的金器都毁坏了，正如耶和华所说的；
24.en: He carried out from there all the treasures of the LORD’s house and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the LORD’s temple, as the LORD had said.

24.zh: 又将耶路撒冷的众民和众首领，并所有大能的勇士，共一万人，连一切木匠、铁匠都掳了去；除了国中极贫穷的人以外，没有剩下的；
24.en: He carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valor, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and the smiths. No one remained except the poorest people of the land.

24.zh: 并将约雅斤和王母、后妃、太监，与国中的大官，都从耶路撒冷掳到巴比伦去了；
24.en: He carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, with the king’s mother, the king’s wives, his officers, and the chief men of the land. He carried them into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

24.zh: 又将一切勇士七千人和木匠、铁匠一千人，都是能上阵的勇士，全掳到巴比伦去了。
24.en: All the men of might, even seven thousand, and the craftsmen and the smiths one thousand, all of them strong and fit for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

24.zh: 巴比伦王立[约雅斤]的叔叔玛探雅代替他作王，给玛探雅改名叫西底家。
24.en: The king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s father’s brother, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

24.zh: 西底家登基的时候年二十一岁，在耶路撒冷作王十一年。他母亲名叫哈慕她，是立拿人耶利米的女儿。
24.en: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

24.zh: 西底家行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，是照约雅敬一切所行的。
24.en: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

24.zh: 因此耶和华的怒气在耶路撒冷和犹大发作，以致将人民从自己面前赶出。
24.en: For through the anger of the LORD, this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Then Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

25.zh: 西底家背叛巴比伦王。他作王第九年十月初十日，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒率领全军来攻击耶路撒冷，对城安营，四围筑垒攻城。
25.en: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it around it.

25.zh: 于是城被围困，直到西底家王十一年。
25.en: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

25.zh: 四月初九日，城里有大饥荒，甚至百姓都没有粮食。
25.en: On the ninth day of the fourth month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

25.zh: 城被攻破，一切兵丁就在夜间从靠近王园两城中间的门[逃跑]。迦勒底人正在四围攻城，[王]就向亚拉巴逃走。
25.en: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden (now the Chaldeans were against the city around it); and the king went by the way of the Arabah.

25.zh: 迦勒底的军队追赶王，在耶利哥的平原追上他；他的全军都离开他四散了。
25.en: But the Chaldean army pursued the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

25.zh: 迦勒底人就拿住王，带他到在利比拉的巴比伦王那里审判他。
25.en: Then they captured the king and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they passed judgment on him.

25.zh: 在西底家眼前杀了他的众子，并且剜了西底家的眼睛，用铜链锁着他，带到巴比伦去。
25.en: They killed Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes, then put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

25.zh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒十九年五月初七日，巴比伦王的臣仆、护卫长尼布撒拉旦来到耶路撒冷，
25.en: Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

25.zh: 用火焚烧耶和华的殿和王宫，又焚烧耶路撒冷的房屋，就是各大户家的房屋。
25.en: He burned the LORD’s house, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem. He burned every great house with fire.

25.zh: 跟从护卫长迦勒底的全军就拆毁耶路撒冷四围的城墙。
25.en: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down the walls around Jerusalem.

25.zh: 那时护卫长尼布撒拉旦将城里所剩下的百姓，并已经投降巴比伦王的人，以及大众所剩下的人，都掳去了。
25.en: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive the rest of the people who were left in the city and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon—all the rest of the multitude.

25.zh: 但护卫长留下些民中最穷的，使他们修理葡萄园，耕种田地。
25.en: But the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to work the vineyards and fields.

25.zh: 耶和华殿的铜柱，并耶和华殿的[盆]座和铜海，迦勒底人都打碎了，将那铜运到巴比伦去了，
25.en: The Chaldeans broke up the pillars of bronze that were in the LORD’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in the LORD’s house, and carried the bronze pieces to Babylon.

25.zh: 又带去锅、铲子、蜡剪、调羹，并所用的一切铜器，
25.en: They took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.

25.zh: 火鼎、碗，无论金的银的，护卫长也都带去了。
25.en: The captain of the guard took away the fire pans, the basins, that which was of gold, for gold, and that which was of silver, for silver.

25.zh: 所罗门为耶和华殿所造的两根[铜]柱、一个[铜]海，和几个[盆]座，这一切的铜，多得无法可称。
25.en: The two pillars, the one sea, and the bases, which Solomon had made for the LORD’s house, the bronze of all these vessels was not weighed.

25.zh: 这一根柱子高十八肘，柱上有铜顶，高三肘；铜顶的周围有网子和石榴，都是铜的。那一根柱子，照此一样，也有网子。
25.en: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and a capital of bronze was on it. The height of the capital was three cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital around it, all of bronze; and the second pillar with its network was like these.

25.zh: 护卫长拿住大祭司西莱雅、副祭司西番亚，和三个把门的，
25.en: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold;

25.zh: 又从城中拿住一个管理兵丁的官，并在城里所遇常见王面的五个人和检点国民军长的书记，以及城里遇见的国民六十个人。
25.en: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and five men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe, the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the city.

25.zh: 护卫长尼布撒拉旦将这些人带到在利比拉的巴比伦王那里。
25.en: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

25.zh: 巴比伦王就把他们击杀在哈马地的利比拉。这样，犹大人被掳去离开本地。
25.en: The king of Babylon attacked them and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.

25.zh: 至于犹大国剩下的民，就是巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒所剩下的，巴比伦王立了沙番的孙子、亚希甘的儿子基大利作他们的省长。
25.en: As for the people who were left in the land of Judah whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, governor.

25.zh: 众军长和属他们的人听见巴比伦王立了基大利作省长，于是军长尼探雅的儿子以实玛利、加利亚的儿子约哈难、尼陀法人单户篾的儿子西莱雅、玛迦人的儿子雅撒尼亚，和属他们的人都到米斯巴见基大利。
25.en: Now when all the captains of the forces, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, Johanan the son of Kareah, Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.

25.zh: 基大利向他们和属他们的人起誓说：「你们不必惧怕迦勒底臣仆，只管住在这地服事巴比伦王，就可以得福。」
25.en: Gedaliah swore to them and to their men, and said to them, “Don’t be afraid because of the servants of the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.”

25.zh: 七月间，宗室以利沙玛的孙子、尼探雅的儿子以实玛利带着十个人来，杀了基大利和同他在米斯巴的犹大人与迦勒底人。
25.en: But in the seventh month, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal offspring came, and ten men with him, and struck Gedaliah so that he died, with the Jews and the Chaldeans that were with him at Mizpah.

25.zh: 于是众民，无论大小，连众军长；因为惧怕迦勒底人，都起身往埃及去了。
25.en: All the people, both small and great, and the captains of the forces arose and came to Egypt; for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.

25.zh: 犹大王约雅斤被掳后三十七年，巴比伦王以未·米罗达元年十二月二十七日，使犹大王约雅斤抬头，提他出监；
25.en: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, released Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison,

25.zh: 又对他说恩言，使他的位高过与他一同在巴比伦众王的位，
25.en: and he spoke kindly to him and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,

25.zh: 给他脱了囚服。他终身常在[巴比伦]王面前吃饭。
25.en: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life;

25.zh: 王赐他所需用的食物，日日赐他一分，终身都是这样。
25.en: and for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him from the king, every day a portion, all the days of his life.
